2640.summary: The Albert bridge now exposes environmental impacts as `impacts` result metadata (energy in `kWh`, emissions in `kgCO2eq`) on buffered and streamed results, replacing the deprecated `carbon` field.

2624.summary: `ServerException` and `RateLimitExceededException` now implement the new `RetryableExceptionInterface`, so a retry policy can tell transient failures from permanent ones with a single `instanceof` check.

2620.summary: `McpToolbox::getTools()` now carries a remote tool's `readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint` and `openWorldHint` annotations into `Tool::getMetadata()`, so you can decide, for example, whether a call needs approval.

2619.summary: `Progress` now has `STAGE_MODEL_REQUEST`, `STAGE_DELTA`, `STAGE_TOOL_CALL` and `STAGE_HANDOFF` constants, so you can match agent progress updates without hard-coding raw stage strings.

2592.summary: Mate's `symfony-service-detail` tool now reports the definition flags `debug:container` shows (`public`, `synthetic`, `lazy`, `shared`, `abstract`, `autowire`, `autoconfigure`), so an agent can see how a service is configured.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate tools:call symfony-service-detail --id=App\\EventListener\\RequestListener --format=json

2587.summary: Mate's `monolog-search`, `monolog-context-search` and `monolog-tail` responses now include `total_matched` and `truncated`, so an agent reads a count instead of counting entries itself.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate tools:call monolog-tail --level=error --format=json
# {"entries": [...], "total_matched": 42, "truncated": true}

2585.summary: `tools:call --format=pretty` now prints one unpadded `key: value` line per result field, so one long value no longer pads every other row with whitespace.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate tools:call server-info --format=pretty

2584.summary: `tools:call` now switches pretty output to JSON when the result is larger than 8 KB and prints a note explaining why. Pass `--format=pretty` to force pretty output, or use `--format=toon` for compact output.

snippet.code:
# large results fall back to JSON automatically
vendor/bin/mate tools:call symfony-services

# token-efficient alternative
vendor/bin/mate tools:call symfony-services --format=toon

2574.summary: The ClickHouse, ManticoreSearch, Milvus, Neo4j, OpenSearch and Supabase stores get a `StoreFactory`, and their `Store` takes a pre-scoped HTTP client. In the AI Bundle you can set `http_client` instead of endpoint and credentials.

2558.summary: The Mistral, OpenAI and OpenRouter model catalogs now include newly released models, such as OpenAI's `gpt-4o-realtime-preview` realtime models and new OpenRouter entries.

2557.summary: The Higgsfield, Venice and Replicate bridges now return a `JobResult` with a serializable `JobHandle` instead of polling inside `invoke()`. `JobRunner` gains a `maxPolls` limit, and handles report their own poll interval.

2556.summary: The OpenAI bridge supports batch requests: pass many keyed inputs with `['batch' => true]` to get a job handle, then read the `BatchResult` items later through the OpenAI job client, at about half the price.

2549.summary: The new TypeSafe bridge evaluates typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) about a piece of content with the Jev models. Answers come back as calibrated probabilities, useful for classification, routing and guardrails.

2525.summary: The demo application has a new design based on the Symfony AI design system, with suggested prompts in each chat.

2524.summary: Agent calls, platform invocations and tool executions now appear in the `ai` category of the Symfony profiler's performance timeline when debug mode is on.

2517.summary: The Albert bridge now exposes the environmental footprint that Albert reports with each call as `carbon` result metadata, on buffered and streamed results.

2515.summary: Mate's `symfony-service-detail` now shows constructor arguments with their parameter names, so you can see which services are wired in, such as a messenger bus's middleware. Values that look like secrets are redacted.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate tools:call symfony-service-detail --id=messenger.bus.default --format=json

2510.summary: Add `#[MapToolArguments]` to a tool's single DTO parameter to expose the DTO's properties at the root of the tool schema. The flat tool-call payload is then mapped onto that DTO.

2502.summary: The Anthropic, Cerebras, Gemini, OpenAI and OpenRouter model catalogs now include newly released models.

2497.summary: The new MCP tool bridge lets an agent use the tools of a remote MCP server through `McpToolbox`. In the AI Bundle, add an `mcp_server` tool entry that points to a connection configured under `mcp.clients`.

snippet.code:
# config/packages/mcp.yaml
mcp:
    clients:
        research:
            servers:
                filesystem:
                    transport: stdio
                    command: ['npx', '-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem', '%kernel.project_dir%/var']

# config/packages/ai.yaml
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            tools:
                - { mcp_server: 'research.filesystem' }

2495.summary: Stores, retrievers, rerankers and vectorizers now use the new `VectorDocumentInterface` instead of the final `VectorDocument` class, so a store can return richer documents, such as entities. `VectorDocument` stays the default.

2494.summary: `VectorQuery` and `HybridQuery` now accept any `VectorInterface`, so you can pass a returned document's vector straight back into a query for "more like this" searches, without a cast.

2493.summary: `SourceIndexer` now passes its options to the loader too, not only to the document processor, so you can narrow a source for each indexing run (for example, only published items).

2492.summary: Provider-hosted web searches on Anthropic and OpenResponses are now kept for the next turn, buffered or streamed, when you pass the result to `Message::ofAssistant()`. Streams emit a `WebSearchComplete` delta for each search.

2488.summary: Mate's `tools:list` now shows an `Arguments` column and full tool descriptions. When a `tools:call` parameter is wrong or missing, the error points you to `tools:inspect`.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate tools:list
vendor/bin/mate tools:inspect monolog-search

2487.summary: `HttpCassette` now redacts recorded request bodies with the new `BodyRedactor` by default. Credentials are always removed, personal data is removed unless you opt out, and you can add your own patterns.

2483.summary: `MultiAgent` and `SpeechAgent` now forward the `Progress` updates of the agents they delegate to. `MultiAgent` also reports its routing as a `handoff` stage, with the orchestrator's `Decision` as payload.

2479.summary: Mate adds the `symfony-dotenv-check` tool and `symfony-dotenv-diagnostics` skill: they report which `.env*` file declares each variable and where its runtime value comes from, without ever returning raw values. Requires `symfony/dotenv`.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate tools:call symfony-dotenv-check
vendor/bin/mate tools:call symfony-dotenv-check --key=DATABASE_URL

2477.summary: `skills:install` now prints a per-skill status table with an `Action` column (installed, rebuilt, skipped, unchanged), and supports `--format=json` and `--format=toon` like `skills:list`.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate skills:install
vendor/bin/mate skills:install --dry-run
vendor/bin/mate skills:install --format=json

2475.summary: Streamed Codex results now include token usage, read from the `turn.completed` event, in the result metadata.

2471.summary: Call `Execution::cancel()` to stop a running agent execution, for example from a signal handler or a chat "stop" button. It aborts the active HTTP response and also cancels the agents a `MultiAgent` or `SpeechAgent` delegates to.

2469.summary: When an HTTP cassette is replayed, each outgoing request's method, URL, query and body are now checked against the recorded signature. A changed bridge payload then fails right away instead of getting a stale recorded response.

2467.summary: `ResultConvertedEvent` and `ResultErrorEvent` now expose `getProvider()`, so listeners can tell which of a platform's providers served the request, for example to release held capacity.

2457.summary: Mate skills now ship with the extension whose tools they use, so a project only installs skills it can actually run. Removing an extension also removes its skills, and existing projects migrate on their own.

2454.summary: When `mate.invocation` wraps the binary (for example `ddev exec vendor/bin/mate`), `mate init` now detects the PHP version by running `php` through that wrapper. This way it records the container's PHP version, not the host's.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate init
# Asking "ddev exec vendor/bin/mate" which PHP it runs...

2452.summary: Mate's `monolog-tail` tool now takes a `limit` parameter instead of `lines`, like `monolog-search` and `monolog-context-search`.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate tools:call monolog-tail --level=error --limit=50

2451.summary: The MCP Bundle supports the 2026-07-28 MCP revision (no handshake, no session) on the existing endpoint. New `protocol_versions`, `request_state`, `cache` and `subscriptions` server options let you configure it.

snippet.code:
# config/packages/mcp.yaml
mcp:
    servers:
        api:
            protocol_versions: ['2025-11-25', '2026-07-28']
            http:
                path: /mcp
            registry: '*'

2450.summary: `Message::ofAssistant()` now accepts a streamed result too. It rebuilds the assistant turn as the provider produced it (text, signed thinking blocks, tool calls), so multi-turn conversations replay correctly, streamed or not.

2442.summary: The DeepSeek and OpenRouter model catalogs now include newly released models, such as `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`.

2441.summary: `ServerConnectionInterface::complete()` forwards `completion/complete` to a remote MCP server, so a bundle-configured client can ask the server to complete a prompt or resource-template argument.

2437.summary: Platform adds `CassetteHttpClient`, `HttpCassette` and `AbstractBridgeReplayTestCase`, so you can record real provider responses once and replay them offline in tests through the full bridge pipeline.

2436.summary: `AgentInterface::call()` now returns a lazy `Execution`. You can read the result directly, iterate it to see each model request, tool call and streamed delta as a `Progress` update, or register `onProgress()` and `onResult()` callbacks.

2435.summary: `skills:install --dry-run` shows what a run would install, rebuild or remove without writing anything. `skills:validate` now warns about broken links in a skill and suggests improvements for vague descriptions.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate skills:install --dry-run
# Would install 1 new skill: mate-symfony-profiler
# Would rebuild 1 skill: mate-system-information

vendor/bin/mate skills:validate --strict

2434.summary: The new Mate commands `skills:disable` and `skills:enable` hide or restore a single skill and rebuild or remove its generated folders, so you no longer have to edit `mate/extensions.php` by hand.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate skills:disable system-information
vendor/bin/mate skills:enable system-information

2433.summary: The new Mate commands `skills:override` and `skills:reset` let you take ownership of a skill by copying it into `mate/skills/<name>/`, and hand it back to Mate later.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate skills:override mate-system-information
vendor/bin/mate skills:reset system-information --delete-copy

2431.summary: System prompts loaded from a file in the AI Bundle can now contain `{placeholder}` markers. They are replaced at call time with the `template_vars` you pass.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            model: 'gpt-5-mini'
            prompt:
                # the file may contain {placeholder} markers, filled from "template_vars"
                file: '%kernel.project_dir%/prompts/assistant.txt'

2429.summary: The AI Bundle's `chromadb` store now takes an `embedding_function` option, so a store configured in YAML can answer `TextQuery` searches by embedding the query on the client side.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        chromadb:
            symfonycon:
                collection: 'symfony_blog'
                embedding_function: 'app.chromadb.embedding_function'

2428.summary: You can now create OpenAI Realtime sessions for voice agents. Your server gets a short-lived client secret in a `RealtimeSessionResult`, and the browser or mobile client uses it to connect to OpenAI over WebRTC or WebSocket.

2417.summary: The new Eden AI bridge gives you access to the gateway's OpenAI-compatible chat and embeddings, plus expert models for OCR, document parsing, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, image analysis and image generation.

2415.summary: The Gemini and OpenRouter model catalogs now include newly released models, such as `gemini-3.7-flash`.

2412.summary: The MCP Bundle can now expose several named MCP servers, each with its own route and `registry` of capabilities. It can also act as a client to remote MCP servers through named `clients`.

2408.summary: Platform supports asynchronous jobs: a provider that answers with a job ID returns a `JobResult` with a serializable `JobHandle`, which you can store, resolve later in a worker, or wait on with `JobRunner`. MiniMax uses it first.

2406.summary: Mate's `ai_mate_symfony.cache_dir` and `ai_mate_monolog.log_dir` now accept a map of context names to directories, so one Mate setup can inspect the containers and logs of a multi-kernel (`APP_ID`) application.

2399.summary: The ChromaDB store now accepts an optional `EmbeddingFunction`, so a `TextQuery` can be embedded client-side. `supports(TextQuery::class)` only returns `true` when one is configured.

2396.summary: Streamed tool calls follow one shape across bridges: each call is announced with `ToolCallStart`, arguments follow as `ToolInputDelta` where the provider streams them, and a single terminal `ToolCallComplete` carries all calls.

2383.summary: Mate tools that return data from your application (logs, profiler data, container metadata) now wrap it in an `untrusted_data` key with a `_security_notice`, against prompt injection. Custom tools can use `ResponseEncoder::encodeUntrusted()`.

2382.summary: The OpenResponses bridge now converts `custom_tool_call` items, for example from xAI's `x_search`, into a `CustomToolCallResult` instead of failing. These calls were already run by the provider and need no answer from your application.

2381.summary: The OpenResponses bridge now exposes `url_citation` annotations as a deduplicated `citations` list in the text result metadata, like the Perplexity bridge does.

2380.summary: Mate is now a plain CLI instead of an MCP server: coding agents run `vendor/bin/mate tools:call ...` directly and find it through generated `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` instructions and skills. Custom tools use the `#[MateTool]` attribute.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate tools:list
vendor/bin/mate tools:inspect symfony-profiler-list
vendor/bin/mate tools:call symfony-profiler-list --limit=1
vendor/bin/mate skills:install

2379.summary: The Mistral and OpenRouter model catalogs list new models, such as `voxtral-mini-tts-latest`, the Voyage 4 embedding models and `qwen/qwen3.7-flash`.

2374.summary: The OpenResponses bridge keeps reasoning items as thinking signatures and sends them back on the next request, so `store: false` conversations keep the model's reasoning context across turns and after tool calls.

2373.summary: The `Agent` now runs the tool-calling loop itself: pass a `toolbox` to the constructor instead of wiring `AgentProcessor`. Tool execution sits behind the new, replaceable `ToolExecutorInterface`.

2372.summary: When OpenAI reports an overloaded server inside a `response.failed` event, the OpenResponses bridge throws a `ServerException`, so your existing retry setup retries the request instead of giving up.

2370.summary: Mate now installs skills as copies under `.agents/skills/mate-<name>/`, mirrored to `.claude/skills/`, and records their state in `mate/extensions.php`. New `skills:list`, `skills:validate` and `skills:prune` commands help you manage them.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate discover        # register new extensions and install their skills
vendor/bin/mate skills:install  # rebuild the generated skill folders
vendor/bin/mate skills:list     # show which skills are enabled and how
vendor/bin/mate skills:validate # check the generated folders

2368.summary: You can point the OpenRouter `ModelApiCatalog` at a different base URL, e.g. a self-hosted proxy or another OpenRouter-compatible API.

snippet.code:
use Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\OpenRouter\ModelApiCatalog;

$catalog = new ModelApiCatalog($httpClient, 'https://openrouter-proxy.example.com/api');

2366.summary: The Anthropic, Gemini and OpenRouter model catalogs list new models, including `claude-opus-5`, `gemini-3.1-flash-image` and the Gemini deep-research previews.

2363.summary: Stream listeners get a new `onError()` hook with an `ErrorEvent` when draining a `StreamResult` throws. Use it to record cost or quota for a stream that failed after reporting usage.

2362.summary: `ValidateToolCallArgumentsListener` also enforces `#[Schema]` constraints on scalar and array tool parameters, like `pattern`, `minimum`/`maximum`, `enum` or `minItems`. A malformed tool call is rejected before it reaches your tool.

2354.summary: The Anthropic, Claude Code, Cohere and Generic-based bridges throw `MalformedToolCallException` when the model returns tool call arguments that are not valid JSON, instead of failing later with an unclear error.

2353.summary: `AgentInterface::call()` accepts a plain string or a single `UserMessage` as well as a `MessageBag`, so one-off questions no longer need a message bag.

2352.summary: The `mcp` profiler panel shows all registered tools, prompts, resources and resource templates on every request, not only on MCP requests, and lists the handler of each one.

2350.summary: The new `debug:mcp` command lists the registered MCP tools, prompts, resources and resource templates with their handlers. Pass a name to see one element's details, including its input schema.

snippet.code:
# list all MCP capabilities with their handlers
php bin/console debug:mcp

# show the details of a single element, e.g. a tool's input schema
php bin/console debug:mcp current-time

2349.summary: The MCP Bundle registers tools, prompts and resources from container services at compile time instead of scanning the filesystem. Schemas are cached in the compiled container and the `mcp.discovery` config is gone.

2336.summary: The OpenResponses bridge throws the new `MalformedToolCallException` when a tool call carries arguments that are not valid JSON, so you can catch this case on its own.

2335.summary: The OpenResponses bridge throws `MaxOutputTokensException` when a response stops at its output token limit. `IncompleteStreamException` is now only used for streams that were cut off unexpectedly.

2332.summary: You can now include `Audio` content in Mistral chat messages to use Voxtral audio understanding with models such as `voxtral-small-latest`. A single call can transcribe and reason over a recording.

2331.summary: The Mistral bridge now supports Voxtral speech-to-text through the `/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoint. Wrap the model in `SpeechToText` to use it for transcription.

2326.summary: Gemini and Vertex AI streams frame thinking with `ThinkingStart`, `ThinkingDelta` and `ThinkingComplete` deltas. Multi-part candidates are split into separate deltas instead of causing a crash.

2317.summary: A model router can now choose the model, not just the provider: `resolve()` returns a `RoutingDecision` that names the provider and can replace the model and options. This makes input-, rule- or cost-based routing possible.

2316.summary: Tools can carry your own metadata through `#[AsTool(metadata: [...])]`, which you read with `Tool::getMetadataValue()`. Use it to filter the toolset or gate calls, e.g. for human-in-the-loop confirmation.

2315.summary: The AI Bundle passes the `serializer` to `TemplateRendererListener`, so you can pass objects as `template_vars` and reference their properties with dotted placeholders like `{product.name}`.

2314.summary: The JSON Schema `Factory` accepts a context on `buildProperties()` and `buildParameters()`. Its `serializer_groups` key limits the generated schema to properties in those Serializer groups.

2313.summary: The Gemini, OpenAI and OpenRouter model catalogs list new models, including the `gpt-5.6` family, `gpt-realtime-2.1` and `gemini-omni-flash-preview`.

2310.summary: `AiAssertionsTrait` adds assertions on profiler data to functional tests: platform call count, called models, invoked and registered tools. Test what an agent did instead of its non-deterministic answers.

2305.summary: `StoreInterface::clear()` removes all documents from a store but keeps its table, index or collection, so you can re-index without calling `setup()` again. The new `ai:store:clear` command does the same from the console.

2304.summary: `MessageBag::isLastMessageFrom()` tells you whether the last message in the bag has a given role, for example to make sure a user message is still waiting for an answer.

2292.summary: When you run `ai:platform:invoke` without a model argument, the command lets you pick one from the platform's model catalog.

snippet.code:
# prompts for the model with a list of the catalog's models
php bin/console ai:platform:invoke openai

2291.summary: Structured output throws an `InvalidArgumentException` when `response_format` looks like a class name but the class does not exist, which helps you find a missing `use` import.

2290.summary: Results expose why the model stopped as `finish_reason` metadata, for buffered and streamed results across most bridges. A `FinishReason` object maps provider values onto `FinishReasonCase` and keeps the raw value.

2284.summary: The Vertex AI bridge derives the API host from the configured `location`, so regional endpoints (e.g. `europe-west1`) and the `eu`/`us` data-residency endpoints work.

2282.summary: The AI Bundle registers `StringToMessageBagListener` by default, so you can pass a plain string to a platform and it is turned into a `MessageBag` for you.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('gpt-5-mini', 'What is the capital of France?');

echo $result->asText();

2281.summary: The Anthropic bridge throws the new `MaxOutputTokensException` when a stream stops at the `max_tokens` limit. Retrying would truncate again, so you can handle it separately and raise the budget.

2278.summary: The new Higgsfield bridge generates images and videos from text prompts or reference images. Short model aliases such as `soul-2` and `kling-2.5-i2v` are available, and the AI Bundle has a `higgsfield` platform configuration.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        # Higgsfield issues a key id and a key secret, both are required
        higgsfield:
            api_key: '%env(HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY)%'
            api_secret: '%env(HIGGSFIELD_API_SECRET)%'

2276.summary: Streamed completions from the Generic (OpenAI-compatible) bridge expose the provider's `finish_reason` as result metadata once the stream has been consumed.

2272.summary: ElevenLabs speech-to-text forwards Scribe options such as `language_code`, `diarize` and `additional_formats`. Requested formats like SRT subtitles come back as a typed `Transcript` through `asObject()`.

2271.summary: `mate init` asks which PHP binary your coding agent should use to start Mate and writes it into `mcp.json`. It defaults to `ddev exec php` when a `.ddev/` directory exists, so containerized setups work.

snippet.code:
$ vendor/bin/mate init
 PHP binary to run Mate for your coding agent [ddev exec php]:
 > docker compose exec php php

2263.summary: The Bedrock bridge now supports the Bedrock Mantle endpoint, with its OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs and the Anthropic Messages API. You can authenticate with a Bedrock API key or with AWS SigV4.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        bedrock:
            openweight:
                api: completions
                api_key: '%env(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)%'
                region: '%env(AWS_DEFAULT_REGION)%'
            claude:
                api: messages
                api_key: '%env(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)%'
                region: '%env(AWS_DEFAULT_REGION)%'

2250.summary: With the `mcp.http.allowed_hosts` option you can expose a public MCP server over HTTP: list the hosts the DNS rebinding protection accepts, or set it to `false` to turn the protection off.

snippet.code:
mcp:
    http:
        allowed_hosts: ['example.com', 'mcp.example.com']
        # or, behind a reverse proxy that validates the Host header:
        # allowed_hosts: false

2248.summary: When an OpenAI Responses built-in tool runs (web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP, ...), its output item becomes a typed result such as `WebSearchResult`, instead of being dropped.

2237.summary: The MCP Bundle supports MCP Apps: `#[AsMcpApp]` and `#[AsMcpAppTool]` turn a service and Twig templates into interactive HTML UIs that MCP hosts render in a sandboxed iframe. No client-side JavaScript or protocol code is needed.

2231.summary: `DirectoryLoader` scans a directory and passes each file to a loader chosen by its extension, optionally recursing into subdirectories. Files without a matching loader are skipped.

2224.summary: OpenAI image generation uses the `gpt-image-*` models instead of the retired DALL-E. Pass a source image through the `image` option to edit it.

2222.summary: `ResultConvertedEvent` and `ResultErrorEvent` fire when a deferred result is actually converted, or when conversion fails. Listeners can act on the resolved result or replace it.

2215.summary: Platform and store bridges handle base URLs the same way and accept them with or without a trailing slash. Mistral, DeepSeek, Gemini, Cohere and others gain a `baseUrl` argument to target compatible endpoints.

2213.summary: Mate extensions can ship Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`) through the `extra.ai-mate.skills` key. `mate discover` or the new `mate skills:install` command links them into `.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/` for your coding agent.

snippet.code:
# runs automatically as part of discover, after composer require
vendor/bin/mate discover

# explicit re-sync
vendor/bin/mate skills:install

2212.summary: Tool results can contain multimodal content such as images: `Message::ofToolCall()` accepts content objects. Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini and Vertex AI send them natively, other bridges fall back to text.

2209.summary: The Anthropic bridge takes a `baseUrl` argument, so you can route requests through an Anthropic-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM or Cloudflare AI Gateway.

2208.summary: The Anthropic prompt-caching logic moved into a reusable `PromptCachingTrait`, so other Anthropic model clients can share the `cache_control` handling.

2199.summary: The Elasticsearch store now has a `StoreFactory` that scopes an HTTP client to your endpoint, and in the AI Bundle you can configure the store with a pre-scoped `http_client` instead of an `endpoint`.

2196.summary: The Anthropic bridge supports a `server_tools` option that enables Anthropic's hosted `web_search` and `code_execution` tools. Web searches come back as a `WebSearchResult` with query, id and status.

2195.summary: The new Fireworks AI bridge supports chat completions with streaming, tool calling and structured output, as well as embeddings, reranking and image generation, with a model catalog loaded from the Fireworks API.

2185.summary: `MessageBag::withoutToolMessages()` returns a copy of the bag without tool-call messages and tool-call-only assistant messages, which is handy for rendering a chat history.

snippet.code:
$messages = $chat->loadMessages()
    ->withoutSystemMessage()
    ->withoutToolMessages()
    ->getMessages();

2179.summary: The tool-calling loop of an agent is capped at 50 iterations by default and throws `MaxIterationsExceededException` beyond that. Change the limit per agent with `max_tool_calls`, or set it to `null` for no limit.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            model: 'gpt-5-mini'
            max_tool_calls: 75 # default 50, null disables the limit

2167.summary: More bridges throw `ExceedContextSizeException` when a request exceeds the model's context window: Cerebras, Cohere, DeepSeek, Gemini, Mistral, Perplexity, Scaleway and Vertex AI.

2165.summary: The Anthropic, Generic, OpenAI and OpenResponses bridges throw `ExceedContextSizeException` instead of `BadRequestException` when a request exceeds the model's context window, so you can handle it explicitly.

2161.summary: The Mistral bridge supports OCR via `mistral-ocr-latest` and the `/v1/ocr` endpoint. You get a typed `OcrResult` with per-page markdown, layout images and annotations for document URLs, PDFs and images.

2160.summary: `CachePlatform` can cache calls whose input is a content object, such as `DocumentUrl`, `ImageUrl` or `Audio`, so OCR, vision and transcription results are cached too. Custom inputs plug in through a `CacheKeyGenerator`.

2157.summary: Agent tools in the AI Bundle are opt-in: without the `tools` option an agent gets no toolbox. Set `tools: true` to inject all `ai.tool` services, or list the tools you want.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            model: 'gpt-5-mini'
            tools: true # inject all services tagged with "ai.tool"

2155.summary: `SystemPromptInputProcessor::getSystemPrompt()` returns the configured system prompt, so you can show or inspect it without reflection.

2152.summary: The new Together AI bridge gives you access to open-weight chat models, embeddings, image generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text and reranking, with a model catalog loaded from the Together API.

2139.summary: `Platform::invoke()` accepts a fully defined `Model` instance instead of a name, which skips the catalog. Use it for models that are not in the shipped catalog yet.

2131.summary: The Generic completions bridge requests token usage for streamed responses by default by setting `stream_options.include_usage`. If you pass your own `stream_options`, they are kept.

2129.summary: `RecordingProvider` wraps a real provider: the first run records its result into a cassette file, later runs replay it offline without an API key. Use it when a test needs a realistic, deterministic answer.

2128.summary: `CassetteHttpClient` records real HTTP responses to a JSON cassette with credentials redacted and replays them offline, so the bridge's real contract, `ModelClient` and `ResultConverter` run in your tests, SSE streams included.

2123.summary: `MockPlatformFactory` builds a routing-aware mock provider that returns scripted results of any type (text, objects, vectors, streams, tool calls) and records each call for assertions. It complements `InMemoryPlatform`.

2117.summary: The Anthropic bridge marks the system prompt for prompt caching, together with the tools and the last user message. The system prompt is often the largest stable part of a request, so this saves tokens.

2116.summary: Structured output works with streaming: combine `stream: true` with `response_format` and `asStreamedObject()` yields partly filled typed objects as tokens arrive. `asObject()` returns the final, validated object.

2115.summary: `DeferredResult::asPartialJsonStream()` buffers a streamed response and yields the largest valid JSON value each time it changes, so you can render structured output while it streams.

2113.summary: `PartialJsonParser` recovers the largest valid structure from incomplete JSON, so you can render streamed structured output before the model finishes.

2099.summary: The Anthropic and Bedrock Claude clients use the `tool_choice` you pass instead of always forcing `auto`, so you can require a tool call or a specific tool.

2097.summary: The Typesense store gets a `StoreFactory` and accepts a pre-configured (scoped) HTTP client. The bundle supports this through the `http_client` option.

2096.summary: The Cloudflare store gets a `StoreFactory` and accepts a pre-configured (scoped) HTTP client. The bundle supports this through the `http_client` option.

2094.summary: The SurrealDB store gets a `StoreFactory` and accepts a pre-configured (scoped) HTTP client. The bundle supports this through the `http_client` option.

2088.summary: Limit how deep `RstToctreeLoader` follows toctree entries with the new `maxDepth` argument, so you can index only part of a large RST docs tree. The default `null` keeps unlimited recursion.

2081.summary: The Meilisearch store now accepts `HybridQuery` to combine vector and full-text search with a semantic ratio. `VectorQuery` no longer reads `$options['q']` and runs a pure vector search.

2075.summary: Generate speech through OpenRouter: the new `SpeechModelCatalog` adds text-to-speech models, with `voice`, `response_format` and `speed` options. The result is binary audio you can save to a file.

2074.summary: Create Meilisearch stores with the new `StoreFactory`. You can pass an endpoint and API key, or a pre-scoped HTTP client. The bundle gains an `http_client` option for this.

2066.summary: Configure any OpenAI Responses-compatible endpoint, such as a self-hosted gateway or a vLLM deployment, through the new `openresponses` platform in the AI Bundle.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        openresponses:
            local_observe:
                base_url: '%env(AI_TOOLS_BASE_URI)%'
                api_key: '%env(default::AI_TOOLS_API_KEY)%'
                responses_path: '/v1/responses'
    agent:
        observe:
            platform: 'ai.platform.openresponses.local_observe'
            model: 'auto'

2064.summary: The smart cropping demo now crops before scaling, supports all three ratios, and includes preset images that show where smart cropping beats a plain center crop.

2063.summary: Streaming responses from the `ClaudeCode` bridge now yield `ToolCallStart`, `ToolInputDelta` and `ToolCallComplete` deltas, so progress UIs can show when Claude Code calls a tool.

2060.summary: Multi-turn code-execution conversations can now be replayed: `Message::ofAssistant()` maps code-execution results to the new `ExecutableCode` and `CodeExecution` content for Anthropic, Gemini and Vertex AI.

2050.summary: Mate's profiler tools now read the Symfony `logger` collector: error, warning, deprecation and scream counts plus up to 100 log entries with message and context.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:resources:read symfony-profiler://profile/abc123/logger --format=json

2048.summary: Mate's profiler tools now read the Symfony `memory` collector: peak memory usage, the configured memory limit and the percentage of it that the request used.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:resources:read symfony-profiler://profile/abc123/memory

2047.summary: Mate's profiler tools now read the Symfony `time` collector: total request duration, init time and Stopwatch events sorted by duration, which helps find slow requests.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:resources:read symfony-profiler://profile/abc123/time

2046.summary: The new `symfony-service-detail` Mate tool returns the full definition of one container service by its exact ID: class, tags with attributes, method calls and factory.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call symfony-service-detail '{"id": "router"}'

2044.summary: Filter the `symfony-services` Mate tool by DI tag with the new `tag` parameter, for example to list every `kernel.event_listener` or `twig.extension` service.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call symfony-services '{"tag": "kernel.event_listener"}'

2043.summary: The `monolog-tail` Mate tool now accepts a `channel` filter, so you can tail only the logs of one channel such as `security` or `doctrine`, as `monolog-search` already allowed.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call monolog-tail '{"lines": 20, "channel": "security"}'

2041.summary: Rerank documents through OpenRouter with Cohere rerank models from the new `RerankModelCatalog`. Pass a query and a list of texts and get back relevance scores.

2029.summary: Draft refactoring of the Platform dispatch layer: bridges move from a `ModelClient` and `ResultConverter` pair to one `EndpointClientInterface`, and models declare the endpoints they support.

2027.summary: `mate discover --ignore-missing-file` exits successfully without doing anything when `mate/extensions.php` does not exist yet, so Composer scripts can call it on every install.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate discover --composer --ignore-missing-file

2024.summary: `#[Schema(provider: ...)]` points to a `SchemaProviderInterface` service that supplies a JSON Schema fragment at runtime, so tool parameters and structured output can use allowed values from env, a database or services.

2022.summary: Read any MCP resource from the terminal with the new `mcp:resources:read` Mate command. It handles static and templated URIs and prints `pretty`, `json` or `toon` output.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate mcp:resources:read symfony-profiler://profile/abc123
vendor/bin/mate mcp:resources:read symfony-profiler://profile/abc123 --format=json

2021.summary: The `json-input` argument of `mcp:tools:call` now defaults to `{}`, so you can call tools that take no parameters without passing an empty JSON object.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call server-info

2015.summary: Tool calls run by the `ClaudeCode` and `Codex` CLI bridges now show up as `ToolCallResult` parts of a `MultiPartResult`, the same way the Anthropic and Gemini bridges report them.

2013.summary: Mate's Symfony profiler tool and resource template can now be registered without a `ProfilerDataProvider`. In projects without a profiler, they throw a clear error when called.

2002.summary: Structured output can now be validated with Symfony Validator: register `ValidatorSubscriber` and invalid objects throw a `ValidationException` with the violations. The AI Bundle wires it automatically.

2000.summary: `mate init` now sets up your project-local Mate code under a top-level `Mate\` namespace instead of `App\Mate\`. Existing projects need to update their autoload entry.

1993.summary: Create Postgres stores through the new `StoreFactory` from PDO or DBAL, and set the full-text search language with the new `lang` argument or bundle option (default `english`).

1986.summary: `ai:platform:invoke` now asks for any missing platform, model or message when run interactively, with a choice list of the configured platforms.

snippet.code:
bin/console ai:platform:invoke
bin/console ai:platform:invoke openai gpt-5-mini "Hello"

1970.summary: Pass a `tool_config` option to Gemini, for example to give the Google Maps server tool a location. The docs and examples cover the same setup for Vertex AI.

1968.summary: More bridges now report HTTP errors as typed exceptions: 401 as `AuthenticationException`, 400 as `BadRequestException` and 429 as `RateLimitExceededException`, with the provider's error message.

1948.summary: The Vertex AI bridge now returns a `MultiPartResult` when a candidate has several parts, and reports code execution as `ExecutableCodeResult` and `CodeExecutionResult` parts instead of throwing.

1947.summary: The Vertex AI catalog adds the `gemini-3-flash-preview` and `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` models.

snippet.code: $result = $platform->invoke('gemini-3-flash-preview', $messages);

1940.summary: Create ChromaDB stores with the new `StoreFactory`. The bundle's `collection` option is now optional and falls back to the store name.

1937.summary: The Anthropic bridge now returns a `MultiPartResult` when a response has several parts, and exposes code execution server tool output as `ExecutableCodeResult` and `CodeExecutionResult`.

1923.summary: A single `Platform` can now route between several providers: each bridge `Factory` offers `createProvider()`, and the default router sends each model to the provider whose catalog knows it.

1917.summary: A `MessageBag` can now hold several system messages: `getSystemMessage()` joins them into one, separated by a blank line by default.

1908.summary: List the foundation models available on Amazon Bedrock with the new `ai:bedrock:model-list` command, filtered by provider, output modality or inference type. The catalog now matches the Bedrock API.

1907.summary: Load a parameter's JSON Schema from a file with `#[With(ref: ...)]`, which helps when you already have the schema. Other `#[With]` arguments are not allowed next to `ref`.

1905.summary: The new Deepgram bridge adds speech-to-text (`/v1/listen`) and text-to-speech (`/v1/speak`), including streamed audio. Configure it in the bundle under `ai.platform.deepgram`.

1900.summary: The new `MultiPartResult` gives you every part of a model response. Gemini uses it for multi-part candidates and reports code execution as `ExecutableCodeResult` and `CodeExecutionResult` parts.

1896.summary: The Cohere bridge can now transcribe audio with `cohere-transcribe-03-2026`, and its catalog adds vision, translation, reasoning, Aya and v4 rerank models.

1884.summary: Streams now yield a `ThinkingStart` delta when the model begins reasoning, for Anthropic, OpenAI and Open Responses. Together with `ThinkingComplete`, you can tell when the thinking phase starts and ends.

1851.summary: Embedding results from the OpenAI, Generic, Scaleway, Docker Model Runner and Vertex AI bridges now include token usage in their metadata.

1849.summary: The OpenAI and Open Responses bridges now stream reasoning summaries as `ThinkingDelta`, so you can show the model's reasoning while it works.

1842.summary: Create Cache stores with the new `StoreFactory`, which takes a cache pool, a key and a distance strategy name. The bundle's `strategy` option now defaults to `cosine`.

1838.summary: Store MCP sessions with your application's Symfony session handler (Redis, database, filesystem) using the new `framework` session store. Expired sessions are removed when they are read.

snippet.code:
mcp:
    http:
        session:
            store: framework
            prefix: 'mcp-'
            ttl: 3600

1833.summary: The new `symfony/ai-mate-composer-plugin` runs Mate extension discovery after every `composer install` or `update`. If the project has no Mate setup yet, it suggests running `mate init`.

snippet.code:
composer require --dev symfony/ai-mate
vendor/bin/mate init
composer update   # AI Mate  3 extensions synchronized (1 new).

1829.summary: Agents can now run tool calls concurrently with `FiberToolExecutor`, using PHP Fibers and the `SuspendableTrait` for cooperative tools. In the AI Bundle, you choose the executor per agent with the `execution_strategy` option.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            model: 'gpt-5-mini'
            tools:
                execution_strategy: fiber # "sequential" (default), "fiber", or a custom service ID
                services:
                    - 'App\Tool\WeatherTool'
                    - 'App\Tool\CalendarTool'

1826.summary: The new Codex bridge runs OpenAI's Codex CLI as a subprocess, so you can use Codex models from PHP with streaming, token usage and a configurable `sandbox` mode.

1823.summary: `SimilaritySearch` now takes a `RetrieverInterface`, so it gets the retriever's vectorization, hybrid queries and events. An optional prompt template sets the header text of the results.

1822.summary: Mate's `symfony-services` tool now finds the compiled container XML for kernels with custom class names, not only the default `App_KernelDevDebugContainer.xml`.

1819.summary: Mate's profiler tools now read Doctrine DBAL query data: query count, total time, SQL with parameters and repeated queries, which helps you spot N+1 problems.

snippet.code: vendor/bin/mate mcp:resources:read symfony-profiler://profile/abc123/db

1817.summary: ai.symfony.com now publishes an `llms.txt` overview of Symfony AI for LLMs, and the repository has a skill to regenerate it from the codebase.

1807.summary: The OpenAI catalog adds `gpt-5.4-mini` and `gpt-5.4-nano`, with image and PDF input, streaming, structured output and tool calling.

snippet.code: $result = $platform->invoke('gpt-5.4-mini', $messages);

1806.summary: Mate now has fewer, merged MCP tools (16 down to 9), for example a single `server-info` tool and `monolog-search` with a `regex` flag. Every parameter has a description for agents.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call server-info
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call monolog-search '{"term": "Exception.*timeout", "regex": true, "level": "ERROR"}'
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call symfony-profiler-list '{"limit": 1}'

1805.summary: Mate's CLI commands (`mcp:tools:list`, `mcp:tools:inspect`, `mcp:tools:call`, `debug:capabilities`, `debug:extensions`) accept `--format=toon` for compact, token-saving output, useful in agent skills.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:list --format=toon
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call server-info '{}' --format=toon

1800.summary: The new SQLite `VecStore` runs vector search inside SQLite with the sqlite-vec extension, which is faster than computing distances in PHP once you have more than a few thousand documents.

1797.summary: Vectorizers configured in the AI Bundle are now lazy services, and their autowiring alias uses the vectorizer name directly.

1793.summary: The Scaleway catalog adds the `qwen3.5-397b-a17b` chat model, with tool calling and thinking, and the `qwen3-embedding-8b` embedding model.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('qwen3.5-397b-a17b', $messages);
$vectors = $platform->invoke('qwen3-embedding-8b', 'Some text to embed');

1790.summary: The ElevenLabs bridge now fetches its model catalog from the ElevenLabs API through `ModelCatalog`. `ElevenLabsApiCatalog` and the bundle's `api_catalog` option are gone.

1785.summary: You can save binary results such as generated images or audio straight to disk with `asFile()` on `BinaryResult` and `DeferredResult`. An `IOException` is thrown if the target directory is missing or not writable.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('gemini-2.5-flash-image', $messages);

$result->asFile(__DIR__.'/result.png');

1781.summary: The MariaDB store can now use cosine distance through the new `Distance` enum, set by a store argument or the bundle's `distance` option. Euclidean stays the default.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        mariadb:
            my_store:
                connection: default
                distance: cosine

1779.summary: `RstToctreeLoader` now skips toctree entries that point to missing files and logs a warning instead of failing. Pass `throwOnMissingEntry: true` to keep the strict behavior.

1778.summary: `DistanceCalculator` can score documents in batches and keep only the best candidates after each batch, which cuts peak memory for local stores when you query with `maxItems`. Configure the size with `batchSize` (default 100).

1770.summary: A new SQLite store bridge gives you a persistent vector store without extra infrastructure. It uses FTS5 for full-text search and supports `VectorQuery`, `TextQuery` and `HybridQuery`.

1768.summary: The Toolbox now dispatches a `ToolCallRequested` event before each tool runs. Listeners can deny the call with a reason or set a result to skip execution, which is the building block for human-in-the-loop confirmation.

1767.summary: The Ollama bridge now reads model capabilities from your Ollama server via its API instead of a hard-coded catalog. The bundle's `api_catalog` option is gone, and `endpoint` and `api_key` are optional so you can pass a `ScopingHttpClient`.

1766.summary: The `#[With]` attribute accepts `description` and `example`, so you can document tool parameters and structured output properties right where you constrain them.

1765.summary: Mistral embedding results now carry token usage, including prompt and total tokens and rate limit headers. It is the first embeddings bridge to report usage.

1764.summary: The Platform and Agent components now accept `phpdocumentor/reflection-docblock` 6 alongside 5.4.

1763.summary: The Anthropic bridge now also marks the last tool definition with `cache_control`, so system prompt and tools are cached as a prefix independent of the changing messages. It follows your existing `cacheRetention` setting.

1759.summary: Streams now yield typed deltas such as `TextDelta`, `ThinkingDelta`, `ToolCallStart` and `ToolCallComplete` instead of raw strings, so you can handle each kind of event without parsing provider JSON.

1757.summary: The OpenRouter bridge supports `openrouter/free`, OpenRouter's routing model that picks a free model for your request.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('openrouter/free', $messages);

echo $result->asText();

1756.summary: OpenAI-compatible bridges such as Cerebras, DeepSeek, Mistral and Scaleway now share the streaming and tool-call conversion logic of the Generic bridge through `CompletionsConversionTrait`.

1755.summary: `StoreInterface` now extends `\Countable`, and every store bridge implements `count()`, so you can check how many documents a store holds.

snippet.code:
$store->add($documents);

echo count($store); // or $store->count()

1745.summary: The `Retriever` now dispatches a `PreQueryEvent` before vectorization, so you can expand, correct or rewrite the query text and adjust options such as `semanticRatio` before the store is queried.

1739.summary: The Pinecone store accepts `includeMetadata` and `includeValues` query options. Metadata is still fetched by default, but vector values are now skipped unless you ask for them.

1735.summary: The new Cohere bridge supports the v2 API for chat (with streaming and tool calling), embeddings with an `InputType` enum, and reranking, all with token usage. The AI Bundle can configure it.

1733.summary: Ollama models that are not embedding models now report the `OUTPUT_STRUCTURED` capability, so you can use `response_format` with them.

1722.summary: With `symfony/validator` installed, JSON schemas for tool parameters and structured output are now generated from your Validator constraints, so the same attributes validate in PHP and describe the schema for the model.

1719.summary: The Azure OpenAI bridge now talks to the Responses API (`/openai/v1/responses`) instead of Chat Completions, which aligns it with the OpenAI bridge and lets you send PDF documents to GPT models.

1717.summary: The models.dev bridge now loads its data from the `symfony/models-dev` Composer package by default, so you can update model data with Composer. You can still pass an explicit JSON file via `$dataPath`.

snippet.code: composer require symfony/models-dev

1706.summary: `SummaryGeneratorTransformer` asks an LLM to summarize each document during indexing and stores the result in metadata (`getSummary()`). It can also yield separate summary documents for dual indexing.

1705.summary: New `RstLoader` and `RstToctreeLoader` load reStructuredText docs into a store. They split pages at headings and follow `.. toctree::` directives through a whole documentation tree, adding `_title`, `_depth` and `_source` metadata.

1704.summary: Reranking is now a platform capability (`Capability::RERANKING`, `RerankingResult`), with HuggingFace `text-ranking` support. The Store adds a platform-based `Reranker`, a `RerankerListener` and `CombinedStore` for hybrid retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

1701.summary: A new Claude Code platform bridge runs the Claude Code CLI as a model backend, so you can invoke it on a working directory from PHP with streaming and token usage.

1689.summary: The models.dev `PlatformFactory` now knows the API base URLs of providers like Groq, Mistral, Cerebras, Cohere, Perplexity, Together AI and xAI, so you no longer pass `baseUrl` for them.

1687.summary: Create Azure AI Search stores with the new `StoreFactory`, with an endpoint, API key and API version or with a pre-scoped HTTP client. The bundle gains an `http_client` option.

1686.summary: The AI Bundle can now configure an `amazeeai` platform. It fetches the model catalog from the amazee.ai API.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        amazeeai:
            base_url: '%env(AMAZEEAI_BASE_URL)%'
            api_key: '%env(AMAZEEAI_API_KEY)%'

1683.summary: JSON schema generation is now built from pluggable describers (serializer, type info, PropertyInfo, method docblocks, `#[With]`). You can add your own object or property describer; the `Factory` constructor changed accordingly.

1682.summary: `mate init` now generates `bin/codex` and `bin/codex.bat` wrappers that start Codex with Mate's MCP server injected at runtime. `mate discover` also refreshes `mate/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md` and a managed AI Mate section in `AGENTS.md`.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate init
vendor/bin/mate discover

# Start Codex with the Mate MCP server injected
./bin/codex

1681.summary: Validate object arguments of tool calls with Symfony Validator through the new `ValidateToolCallArgumentsListener`. The violations go back to the model, and the AI Bundle registers the listener for you.

1680.summary: PostgreSQL stores in the AI Bundle accept `setup_options` (`vector_type`, `vector_size`, `index_method`, `index_opclass`), which `ai:store:setup` uses when creating the table.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        postgres:
            my_store:
                dbal_connection: 'doctrine.dbal.default_connection'
                table_name: 'my_store'
                setup_options:
                    vector_type: vector
                    vector_size: 1536
                    index_method: ivfflat
                    index_opclass: vector_cosine_ops

1678.summary: The Gemini bridge supports `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` with image, audio and PDF input, streaming, structured output, tool calling and thinking.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('gemini-3.1-pro-preview', $messages);

echo $result->asText();

1671.summary: The Vektor store integration tests now run in the CI pipeline.

1669.summary: Create Weaviate stores with the new `StoreFactory`, either with an endpoint and API key or with a pre-scoped HTTP client. The bundle gains `http_client` and `collection` options.

snippet.code:
use Symfony\AI\Store\Bridge\Weaviate\StoreFactory;

$store = StoreFactory::create('Movies', env('WEAVIATE_HOST'), env('WEAVIATE_API_KEY'));

1661.summary: VertexAI can now use the global endpoint with only an API key, without `location`, `project_id` or the `google/auth` package. The project-scoped endpoint is still used when you set `location` and `project_id`.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        vertexai:
            api_key: '%env(GOOGLE_CLOUD_VERTEX_API_KEY)%'

1656.summary: In debug mode, the AI Bundle decorates every agent with a `TraceableAgent`, so the profiler lists each agent call with its messages and options.

1654.summary: In debug mode, the AI Bundle decorates every store with a `TraceableStore`, so the profiler shows the add, query and remove calls made against your vector stores.

1653.summary: In debug mode, the AI Bundle now uses a compiler pass to wrap all tagged services in traceable decorators. Platforms, stores and chats you register yourself (e.g. several OpenAI platforms with different keys) now show up in the profiler too.

    app.platform.feature_a:
        class: Symfony\AI\Platform\Platform
        factory: ['Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\OpenAi\PlatformFactory', 'create']

        tags: ['ai.platform']

1652.summary: You can now configure the OVH platform in the AI Bundle.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        ovh:
            api_key: '%env(OVH_API_KEY)%'

1644.summary: The Anthropic bridge enables prompt caching by default: it marks the last user message with `cache_control`. Use `cacheRetention` (`short`, `long` or `none`) to control it; cache read and creation tokens appear in token usage.

1641.summary: MongoDB stores in the AI Bundle accept `setup_options.fields`, which adds extra Atlas Search index fields (e.g. filter fields) when you run `ai:store:setup`.

snippet.code:

    store:
        mongodb:
            my_store:
                index_name: vector_index
                setup_options:
                    fields:
                        - { path: 'metadata.store_code', type: 'filter' }

1636.summary: The Mate Symfony profiler extension now exposes translation data to your coding agent: locale, fallback locales, and each message with its domain and state (defined, missing or fallback).

1635.summary: Anthropic and DeepSeek models now support extended thinking. Streams yield `ThinkingContent` objects with the model's reasoning, and `AssistantMessage` can carry thinking content back to the model.

1634.summary: The bundled models.dev data is refreshed, and a script to update it is included.

1633.summary: The Qdrant store now takes a scoped HTTP client. Use the new `StoreFactory::create()` to build it from an endpoint and API key, or pass your own `ScopingHttpClient`. The `endpointUrl` and `apiKey` constructor parameters are gone.

1631.summary: The MCP Bundle can store HTTP sessions in any PSR-16 cache with `store: cache`, e.g. Redis or Doctrine. By default it wraps `cache.app` as `cache.mcp.sessions`; set `cache_pool` and `prefix` to customize.

snippet.code:

    http:
        session:
            store: cache
            cache_pool: 'cache.mcp.sessions'
            prefix: 'mcp-'
            ttl: 3600

1626.summary: The Gemini bridge supports `gemini-3-flash-preview` with image, audio and PDF input, streaming, structured output and tool calling.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('gemini-3-flash-preview', $messages);

echo $result->asText();

1625.summary: The new Venice AI bridge supports chat (with streaming, tool calling, vision and `venice_parameters`), embeddings, image generation and editing, text-to-speech, speech-to-text and video generation.

1622.summary: The models.dev bridge adds a `ModelResolver` that accepts shortcuts: `provider::model`, a bare provider name (resolves to its newest model), or a bare model ID (finds the provider for you).

1620.summary: The models.dev `PlatformFactory` lets you pass a custom models.dev JSON file via `dataPath` and your own `Contract`. Both are forwarded to the specialized bridges it routes to.

1615.summary: The ElevenLabs bridge now uses a scoped HTTP client, and text-to-speech streaming works better. `hostUrl` is renamed to `endpoint` in `PlatformFactory::create()`, and the bundle's `host_url` key is now `endpoint`.

snippet.code:
