    platform:
        elevenlabs:
            api_key: '%env(ELEVEN_LABS_API_KEY)%'
            endpoint: 'https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/'

1614.summary: The Mate Symfony profiler extension now exposes sent emails to your coding agent: recipients, subject, a body preview, extracted links, attachments and the transport used.

1600.summary: Objects in `template_vars` are now normalized with a Serializer normalizer and can be accessed with dot notation like `{city.name}`. Use `template_options.normalizer_context` to control normalization, e.g. with groups.

1599.summary: The Cerebras bridge now supports structured output on all models and tool calling on `gpt-oss-120b`, `qwen-3-32b` and the new `zai-glm-4.7`, both regular and streamed.

1594.summary: A new amazee.ai platform bridge connects to amazee.ai's LiteLLM-based gateway for chat, streaming and embeddings. It is also configurable in the AI Bundle with `base_url` and `api_key`.

1583.summary: Stream chat replies in real time with the new `ChatInterface::stream()`. Once the stream is fully read, the user and assistant messages are saved to the message store.

1581.summary: `MarkdownLoader` loads a Markdown file as a text document, takes the first `#` heading as the title, and can strip Markdown syntax with the `strip_formatting` option.

1580.summary: `JsonFileLoader` turns a JSON file into text documents, using JsonPath expressions for IDs, content and metadata. It requires `symfony/json-path`.

1578.summary: `Subagent` now implements `HasSourcesInterface` and collects the sources of the inner agent's result, so sources are no longer lost when you use an agent as a tool.

1576.summary: A new models.dev platform bridge gives you one factory for the many providers listed on models.dev. It reads model capabilities from the registry and routes to specialized bridges like Anthropic or Gemini when they are installed.

1571.summary: A new Open Responses platform bridge, extracted from the OpenAI bridge, works with any server that implements the Open Responses API. The OpenAI bridge now builds on it.

1570.summary: Store queries now use query objects: `VectorQuery`, `TextQuery` and `HybridQuery`. Use `supports()` to check if a store can handle a query type. This is a BC break: wrap vectors in `VectorQuery` when calling `query()`.

1566.summary: Token usage now reports the model that used the tokens through `getModel()`, so you can price each call accurately when a run mixes models, such as a chat model and an embeddings model.

1561.summary: A new Vektor store bridge adds a file-based vector store built on centamiv/vektor, with no extra server needed. It is also configurable in the AI Bundle under `ai.store.vektor`.

1557.summary: Tool parameters and structured output can now use an interface with a Serializer `DiscriminatorMap`, which becomes a schema listing every implementation. `DateTimeImmutable` values are supported too.

1556.summary: Claude models on AWS Bedrock and the Anthropic API now support structured output via `response_format`. The Bedrock catalog also adds `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`.

1554.summary: A new AWS S3 Vectors store bridge, built on the AsyncAws S3Vectors client, adds vector storage and similarity search. It is also configurable in the AI Bundle under `ai.store.s3vectors`.

1553.summary: `AgentProcessor` now keeps tool call messages in the `MessageBag` by default. `keepToolMessages` is replaced by `excludeToolMessages` for when you want to drop them (BC break).

1551.summary: Leave out the `loader` option on an indexer and the AI Bundle now registers a `DocumentIndexer`, so you can index documents you build in code without loading them from a source.

snippet.code:
ai:
    indexer:
        my_indexer:
            # no loader: creates a DocumentIndexer
            vectorizer: 'ai.vectorizer.openai_small'
            store: 'ai.store.chromadb.documents'

1550.summary: You can pass an object instance as `response_format`: the model fills the missing fields and you get back the same instance. Combined with object `template_vars`, this lets you enrich partial records.

1546.summary: New Filesystem agent tool bridge wraps `symfony/filesystem` as sandboxed tools (read, write, copy, move, delete, list, ...) restricted to a base directory, with extension and pattern filters and opt-in write/delete.

1538.summary: The AI Bundle's web profiler toolbar now shows the number of chats sent, using data the collector already gathered.

1537.summary: `CsvLoader` turns each CSV row into a `TextDocument`. You choose the content, ID and metadata columns and can set the delimiter, enclosure and header handling.

1533.summary: Traceable profiler services and in-memory stores in the AI Bundle, Chat, Store and MCP Bundle now implement `ResetInterface`. Collected data is cleared between requests, which prevents memory growth in long-running workers.

1521.summary: New OVH AI Endpoints platform bridge (`symfony/ai-ovh-platform`) gives you chat, streaming, embeddings, vision, tool calling and structured output against OVH's OpenAI-compatible API.

1520.summary: The Generic platform bridge now extracts token usage from completion responses, so OpenAI-compatible backends like LiteLLM report `token_usage` metadata.

1517.summary: `IndexerInterface::index()` now accepts any iterable of sources, and documents are loaded lazily, so you can feed a generator without loading everything up front.

1513.summary: The Weaviate store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many objects by ID through the batch delete API.

1512.summary: The SurrealDB store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many documents by ID in a single request.

1509.summary: The Typesense store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many documents by ID with a single filtered request.

1507.summary: The Supabase store now implements `remove()`, so you can delete vector documents by ID. Large ID lists are sent in chunks to stay within URL length limits.

snippet.code:
$store->remove($documentId);
$store->remove([$id1, $id2, $id3]);

1506.summary: The Qdrant store now implements `remove()` for one or many point IDs. It respects the store's `async` setting.

1505.summary: The Redis store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many documents by ID with the configured key prefix.

1504.summary: The Postgres store now implements `remove()`, so you can delete one or more documents by ID with a single parameterized `DELETE` query.

snippet.code:
$store->remove('doc-id');
$store->remove(['doc-id-1', 'doc-id-2', 'doc-id-3']);

1503.summary: The OpenSearch store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many documents by ID through the bulk API.

1502.summary: The Neo4j store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many nodes by ID with a single Cypher query.

1501.summary: The MongoDB store now implements `remove()`, so you can delete one or more documents by ID, with bulk-write support.

1500.summary: The Milvus store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many entities by ID.

1499.summary: The Meilisearch store now implements `remove()`, deleting documents by ID through Meilisearch's batch delete endpoint.

snippet.code:
$store->remove('doc-id');
$store->remove(['doc-id-1', 'doc-id-2', 'doc-id-3']);

1498.summary: The MariaDB store now implements `remove()`, so you can delete one or more vector documents by ID.

snippet.code:
$store->remove('doc-id');
$store->remove(['doc-id-1', 'doc-id-2', 'doc-id-3']);

1497.summary: The Elasticsearch store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many documents by ID through the bulk API.

1496.summary: The ManticoreSearch store now implements `remove()`, deleting one or many documents by ID in bulk batches of 1000.

1495.summary: The ChromaDB store now implements `remove()`, so you can delete documents from a collection by ID.

1494.summary: The Cloudflare Vectorize store now implements `remove()`, so you can delete vectors by ID via the `delete_by_ids` endpoint.

1493.summary: The ClickHouse store now implements `remove()`, deleting rows by ID with a parameterized `ALTER TABLE ... DELETE` statement.

snippet.code:
$store->remove('doc-id');
$store->remove(['doc-id-1', 'doc-id-2', 'doc-id-3']);

1492.summary: The Cache store now implements `remove()`, so you can drop single or multiple documents from the cached vector set by ID.

1491.summary: The Azure AI Search store now implements `remove()`, sending `delete` actions for the given document IDs.

snippet.code:
$store->remove('doc-id');
$store->remove(['doc-id-1', 'doc-id-2', 'doc-id-3']);

1490.summary: The in-memory store now implements `remove()`, so you can delete one or more documents by ID, which is handy in tests and prototypes.

1464.summary: `Indexer` is now stateless: you pass the source to `index()` instead of the constructor, and `ConfiguredIndexer` wraps an indexer with a default source. `withSource()` is removed.

1463.summary: The new MiniMax bridge covers chat with streaming and token usage, sync and async text-to-speech, and image, music and video generation. Configure it in the bundle under `ai.platform.minimax`.

1439.summary: Mate tool responses now use the token-saving TOON format when `helgesverre/toon` is installed and fall back to JSON otherwise, which cuts token use when agents read logs, services or profiles.

snippet.code: composer require --dev helgesverre/toon

1431.summary: `SourceCollection` now implements `Countable` and `IteratorAggregate`, so you can `count()` and `foreach` over the sources of a result directly.

1429.summary: You can cap tool-calling iterations with the new `maxToolCalls` argument of `AgentProcessor` to control token costs and prevent infinite loops. A `MaxIterationsExceededException` is thrown when the limit is hit.

1426.summary: Restricts `phpdocumentor/reflection-docblock` to `^5.4` in Agent and Platform to keep CI stable.

1425.summary: Mate extensions can now ship an `INSTRUCTIONS.md` via `extra.ai-mate.instructions`. Mate aggregates these and sends them to the AI assistant during the MCP handshake, so it picks the right tools.

1421.summary: The OpenRouter bridge now supports the `openrouter/bodybuilder` router model, and the catalog documents routers, provider shortcuts and model variants.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('openrouter/bodybuilder', $messages);

echo $result->asText();

1412.summary: New `mcp:tools:call` Mate command runs an MCP tool from the command line with JSON input, validated against the tool's schema, which makes testing and debugging tools easy.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call php-version '{}'
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call monolog-search '{"term": "error"}'
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call php-version '{}' --format=json

1411.summary: New `Ollama` agent tool bridge provides `web_search` and `fetch_webpage` tools backed by Ollama's web search API, with fetched pages tracked as sources.

1408.summary: `TokenUsageAggregation` gains `add()` to append more usages and `count()` to tell how many calls were aggregated, including nested aggregations.

1400.summary: The ElevenLabs text-to-speech client now forwards extra API options like `voice_settings`, so you can tune stability, similarity boost, style and speed.

1398.summary: `TokenUsageAggregation::__construct()` now takes an array of `TokenUsageInterface` instead of variadic arguments, leaving room for future parameters.

snippet.code:
use Symfony\AI\Platform\TokenUsage\TokenUsageAggregation;

$aggregation = new TokenUsageAggregation([$usage1, $usage2]);

1397.summary: `VectorDocument` and `TextDocument` IDs can now be `int`, `string` or `Uuid`, so you can reuse your own identifiers. Store bridges no longer cast IDs to UUIDs.

1394.summary: Platform's `StreamResult` now accepts stream listeners, so you can hook into start, chunk and completion of a stream. The Agent toolbox uses this instead of its own `StreamResult`, and OpenAI reports streamed token usage.

1392.summary: Set `"extension": false` in `extra.ai-mate` to stop a package from being discovered as a Mate extension, e.g. when it only uses Mate for its own development. `mate init` now sets this by default.

1389.summary: `StoreInterface` gains a `remove()` method to delete documents by ID. Pinecone has a full implementation that chunks IDs in batches of 1000; other stores follow.

snippet.code:
$store->remove('vector-id-1');
$store->remove(['vid-1', 'vid-2']);

1387.summary: New `mcp:tools:inspect` Mate command shows a tool's name, description, handler, extension and full JSON input schema, as text or JSON.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:inspect php-version
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:inspect php-version --format=json

1381.summary: The MCP Bundle config now covers the server's `description`, `icons` and `website_url`, which are exposed to clients in the server info.

snippet.code:
mcp:
    app: 'app'
    version: '1.0.0'
    description: 'A sample MCP server for time management.'
    icons:
        - src: 'https://example.com/icon.png'
          mime_type: 'image/png'
          sizes: ['64x64']
    website_url: 'https://example.com'

1379.summary: New `mcp:tools:list` Mate command lists all available MCP tools, with wildcard name filters, per-extension filtering and table or JSON output.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:list
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:list --filter="monolog*"
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:list --extension=symfony/ai-monolog-mate-extension --format=json

1378.summary: The TransformersPHP bridge now passes `input_options` to the pipeline, so you can customize task behavior such as pooling and normalization for embeddings.

1365.summary: The Mistral model catalog now includes the open coding models `devstral-medium-latest` and `devstral-small-latest`, with streaming, structured output and tool calling.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        mistral:
            api_key: '%env(MISTRAL_API_KEY)%'
    agent:
        default:
            model: 'devstral-medium-latest'

1345.summary: OpenRouter models now declare streaming support, and the dynamic `ModelApiCatalog` maps `structured_outputs` to structured output, so `response_format` works with OpenRouter.

1344.summary: The TransformersPHP bridge now converts embeddings and feature-extraction output into a `VectorResult`, so you can create embeddings locally.

1341.summary: The TransformersPHP platform can now be configured through the AI Bundle, so you can run local models without wiring services yourself.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        transformersphp: ~

1339.summary: `CachedPlatform` is now `CachePlatform` and lives in its own `symfony/ai-cache-platform` package. Results are serialized, so any cache adapter (e.g. Redis) works, with optional TTL in the bundle.

1329.summary: The Vertex AI platform config in the AI Bundle gains an `http_client` option, so you can point it at a custom HTTP client service.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        vertexai:
            location: '%env(GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION)%'
            project_id: '%env(GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT)%'
            http_client: 'my_vertex_http_client'

1325.summary: New `debug:extensions` Mate command shows which extensions were discovered, enabled and loaded, with their scan directories and include files.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate debug:extensions
vendor/bin/mate debug:extensions --show-all
vendor/bin/mate debug:extensions --format=json

1320.summary: The Symfony Mate extension can now read Symfony profiler data, so your AI assistant can list, search and inspect profiles and collectors through MCP tools and `symfony-profiler://` resources.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call symfony-profiler-latest '{}'
vendor/bin/mate mcp:tools:call symfony-profiler-search '{"statusCode": 500, "limit": 20}'

1317.summary: `MemoryInputProcessor` now takes an iterable of memory providers instead of variadic arguments, which keeps the constructor open for future parameters.

snippet.code:
use Symfony\AI\Agent\Memory\MemoryInputProcessor;

$memoryProcessor = new MemoryInputProcessor([$embeddingsMemory, $personalFacts]);

1313.summary: Pass `verbose: true` to Whisper (OpenAI and Azure) to get a `Transcript` object with language, duration and timed segments. Transcription usage is now added to the result metadata.

1298.summary: `StoreInterface::add()` now takes a single `VectorDocument` or an array instead of variadic arguments, so future parameters can be added without BC breaks.

snippet.code:
$store->add($document);
$store->add([$document1, $document2]);

1293.summary: New `debug:capabilities` Mate command lists all discovered MCP tools, resources, prompts and templates grouped by extension, with type and extension filters.

snippet.code:
vendor/bin/mate debug:capabilities
vendor/bin/mate debug:capabilities --type=tool
vendor/bin/mate debug:capabilities --extension=symfony/ai-monolog-mate-extension --format=json

1285.summary: Agents and multi-agents are now injected by their configured name, without the `Agent` or `MultiAgent` suffix on the argument name.

1280.summary: New Mate `stop` command stops running servers so your AI client picks up new config. Combine it with `serve --force-keep-alive` to restart the server automatically (requires posix and pcntl).

snippet.code:
# in your MCP client config
vendor/bin/mate serve --force-keep-alive

# after changing config or extensions
vendor/bin/mate stop

1268.summary: The AI Bundle no longer requires `symfony/ai-agent`, `symfony/ai-store` and `symfony/ai-chat`. Install only what you use; a clear error tells you which package to add.

snippet.code:
composer require symfony/ai-bundle symfony/ai-agent
# only when you configure stores or chats
composer require symfony/ai-store symfony/ai-chat

1263.summary: `ResultEvent` now exposes the invocation input via `getInput()`, so a listener can match a result to the call that produced it, for example for logging.

1261.summary: You can now set the MCP protocol version Mate announces via the `mate.mcp_protocol_version` parameter. It defaults to `2025-03-26` for JetBrains AI compatibility.

1257.summary: `Indexer::index()` now accepts `platform_options`, which are forwarded to the vectorizer, so you can pass embedding options while indexing.

1244.summary: Mate's `services.php` configuration files are now called `config.php`, and Mate can load environment variables from a `.mate/.env` file.

1243.summary: Mate's logger now raises an error instead of silently dropping messages when writing the log file fails. Use `MATE_DEBUG_LOG_FILE` to choose a custom log path.

snippet.code: MATE_DEBUG_FILE=1 MATE_DEBUG_LOG_FILE=/var/log/mate/debug.log vendor/bin/mate serve

1242.summary: The demo app now ships an AI Mate setup with a custom `symfony-ai-features` MCP tool that reports the project's configured platforms, agents, tools and stores.

1240.summary: Mate's console commands now have descriptions, so `mate list` explains what each command does.

1239.summary: Mate goes back to calling its plugins "extensions" instead of "bridges": `.mate/extensions.php`, CLI output and the `*-mate-extension` package names.

1238.summary: The Mate MCP server now reports a single name and version, plus a description, website URL and Symfony icon in its server info.

1236.summary: Mate now allows version 0.2 of the `mcp/sdk` package.

1233.summary: The MCP Bundle now requires `mcp/sdk` `^0.2` and drops support for 0.1.

1230.summary: Traceable platform service IDs now include the platform type, so instances with the same name on different platforms no longer collide.

1225.summary: The Bedrock model catalog now includes Claude Opus 4.5 (`claude-opus-4-5-20251101`) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`).

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        bedrock:
            default: ~
    agent:
        default:
            platform: 'ai.platform.bedrock.default'
            model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'

1221.summary: The OpenAI model catalog now includes `gpt-5.2`, with image and PDF input, streaming, structured output and tool calling.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('gpt-5.2', $messages);

echo $result->asText();

1216.summary: The Albert bridge catalog now lists the new open-weight models: `openweight-small`, `openweight-medium` and `openweight-large` for chat, and `openweight-embeddings` for embeddings.

1215.summary: The Pinecone store now implements `ManagedStoreInterface`, so you can create and drop the serverless index with `setup()` and `drop()`. The bundle requires an `index_name` for Pinecone stores.

1209.summary: `ManagedStoreInterface::drop()` now takes an optional `$options` array, so a store bridge can support options when dropping. All bundled stores use the new signature.

1206.summary: You can now configure AWS Bedrock platforms in the AI Bundle, including multiple instances (e.g. per region) with their own Bedrock runtime client.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        bedrock:
            default: ~
            eu:
                bedrock_runtime_client: 'async_aws.client.bedrock_runtime_eu'
    agent:
        nova:
            platform: 'ai.platform.bedrock.default'
            model: 'nova-pro'

1203.summary: The AI Bundle no longer needs the OpenAI bridge to load its configuration. The `region` option is now checked against plain `EU`/`US` values instead of the bridge's constants.

1196.summary: The HttpFoundation message store is renamed to the Session message store, and its namespace is now `Symfony\AI\Chat\Bridge\Session`. The new name says what it does: it keeps chat messages in the Symfony session.

1183.summary: The Scaleway bridge now supports Scaleway's Responses API through the Open Responses bridge, including tool calling, for models such as `gpt-oss-120b`.

1173.summary: The chat Cache bridge's `Store` class is renamed to `MessageStore`, matching the naming of the other message store bridges.

1172.summary: The HttpFoundation `SessionStore` is renamed to `MessageStore`, matching the naming of the other chat message store bridges.

snippet.code:
use Symfony\AI\Chat\Bridge\HttpFoundation\MessageStore;

$store = new MessageStore($requestStack, 'chat');

1171.summary: Chat message store bridges (Cache, Cloudflare, Doctrine, Meilisearch, MongoDB, Pogocache, Redis, Session, SurrealDB) are now separate Composer packages, such as `symfony/ai-redis-message-store`, so you install only the ones you use.

1157.summary: `CachedPlatform` takes an optional Symfony `ClockInterface` for the `cached_at` timestamp, with `MonotonicClock` as the default, which makes it easier to test. The bundle also registers autowiring aliases for cached platforms.

1146.summary: New AI Mate component (`symfony/ai-mate`): a local MCP server that gives AI coding assistants tools for your PHP app, with extension discovery and Symfony container and Monolog log extensions.

snippet.code:
composer require --dev symfony/ai-mate

vendor/bin/mate init
vendor/bin/mate discover

# typically started by your AI assistant
vendor/bin/mate serve

1139.summary: The Vertex AI bridge now supports API key authentication as an alternative to Application Default Credentials, via `PlatformFactory` and the bundle's `api_key` option.

1126.summary: New `FailoverPlatform` (`symfony/ai-failover-platform`) calls the next platform in line when one fails, with a rate limiter controlling retries of failed platforms. It is also configurable in the bundle.

1125.summary: Token usage tracking moves from the Agent into the Platform. Result converters provide a `TokenUsageExtractorInterface`, and the platform adds `token_usage` to the result metadata without any agent processor or bundle configuration.

1122.summary: The Ollama bridge now records token usage. Prompt and completion token counts from Ollama's response are added to the result metadata, for both regular and streamed calls.

1120.summary: The Gemini bridge adds the `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts` and `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts` text-to-speech models. You can generate audio with one speaker or with several named speakers.

1109.summary: New Elasticsearch vector store bridge (`symfony/ai-elasticsearch-store`). You can use Elasticsearch for RAG and configure it under `ai.store.elasticsearch`, with options for vectors field, dimensions and similarity.

1105.summary: In the profiler, Platform Calls now show the full JSON schema of each tool sent to the model, with a button to copy it. This helps you debug tools whose schema is built at runtime.

1103.summary: New `ElevenLabsApiCatalog` loads the available models and their capabilities from the ElevenLabs API instead of a static list. In the bundle, enable it with the `api_catalog` option; this adds extra HTTP calls.

snippet.code:

    platform:
        elevenlabs:
            api_key: '%env(ELEVEN_LABS_API_KEY)%'
            api_catalog: true

1100.summary: The demo application now runs on Symfony 8.

1094.summary: The Bedrock bridge now accepts `async-aws/bedrock-runtime` 1.x as well as 0.1.

1093.summary: All 26 platform bridges are now separate Composer packages, such as `symfony/ai-open-ai-platform` or `symfony/ai-anthropic-platform`. You install only the providers you use, and the AI Bundle tells you which package is missing.

1091.summary: The MCP Bundle now autoconfigures services that implement the SDK's `RequestHandlerInterface` or `NotificationHandlerInterface` and adds them to the MCP server. You can add custom handlers without any manual wiring.

1085.summary: The MCP Bundle now autoconfigures services that implement the SDK's registry `LoaderInterface`, tags them `mcp.loader`, and adds them to the server builder by priority. This lets you register MCP capabilities from your own loaders.

1081.summary: The ChromaDB store now requires `codewithkyrian/chromadb-php` ^1.0. It also gets a `queryTexts` query option for text-based searches; the `queryImages` parameter is gone.

1072.summary: The chat in-memory message store moves out of the bridges into the component itself, as `Symfony\AI\Chat\InMemory\Store`.

1071.summary: The in-memory vector store moves out of the bridges into the Store component, as `Symfony\AI\Store\InMemory\Store`, because it is not a bridge to an external service.

1066.summary: The chat `Local` bridge is split into a `Cache` bridge and a `Memory` bridge, each with its own `Store` class.

1064.summary: `DistanceCalculator` and `DistanceStrategy` move from the `Local` bridge to the `Symfony\AI\Store\Distance` namespace, so any local store can use them.

1063.summary: The vector store `Local` bridge is split into a `Cache` bridge and an `InMemory` bridge, each with its own `Store` class.

1061.summary: The `azure_search` store config key is renamed to `azuresearch`, to match other stores like `manticoresearch`.

    store:
        azuresearch:
            default:
                endpoint: '%env(AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT)%'
                api_key: '%env(AZURE_SEARCH_KEY)%'
                index_name: 'documents'
                api_version: '2024-07-01'

1060.summary: The Azure AI Search store moves from the `Azure` namespace to `Symfony\AI\Store\Bridge\AzureSearch`.

snippet.code: use Symfony\AI\Store\Bridge\AzureSearch\SearchStore;

1059.summary: The Manticore store is renamed to ManticoreSearch: the namespace is now `Symfony\AI\Store\Bridge\ManticoreSearch` and the bundle config key is `manticoresearch`.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        manticoresearch:
            default:
                endpoint: '%env(MANTICORESEARCH_HOST)%'
                table: 'movies'

1058.summary: The OpenRouter bridge now builds on the Generic bridge instead of the OpenAI bridge, and gains an embeddings client. The Generic embeddings converter now throws specific exceptions for authentication, bad request and rate limit errors.

1057.summary: All remaining vector store bridges, from Azure AI Search to Weaviate, are now separate Composer packages such as `symfony/ai-postgres-store`, so you install only the stores you use.

1056.summary: The `chroma_db` store config key is renamed to `chromadb`, so service IDs become `ai.store.chromadb.<name>`.

        chromadb:
            default:
                collection: 'my_collection'

            store: 'ai.store.chromadb.default'

1055.summary: `MessageBag::prepend()` is renamed to `withSystemMessage()`. It returns a copy of the bag with the given system message in place of any existing one.

1054.summary: The Gemini bridge adds the `gemini-2.5-flash-image` and `gemini-3-pro-image-preview` models, which can generate and edit images. The new `BinaryResult::fromBase64()` makes a binary result from base64 data.

1052.summary: New Generic platform bridge for any OpenAI-compatible API, such as LiteLLM. You configure the base URL, API key and a `ModelCatalog` of `CompletionsModel` or `EmbeddingsModel` entries, and no dedicated bridge is needed.

1049.summary: The ChromaDB store is now a separate package, `symfony/ai-chroma-db-store`. If you configure a ChromaDB store without it, the AI Bundle tells you which package to install.

1048.summary: The Mistral catalog adds `ministral-14b-latest`, with streaming, structured output and tool calling.

1039.summary: New OpenSearch vector store bridge. You can use OpenSearch for RAG and configure it under `ai.store.opensearch`, with options for vectors field, dimensions and space type.

    store:
        opensearch:
            movies:
                endpoint: '%env(OPENSEARCH_ENDPOINT)%'

1030.summary: Closures in the Agent and Platform code that do not use `$this` are now static.

1029.summary: ChromaDB query results now include each document's distance as its `score`.

1027.summary: Each `MessageBag` now gets a time-based UUID v7 ID, which you read with `getId()`.

1026.summary: New `Retriever` searches a vector store with a query string: it vectorizes the query and returns similar documents. You can configure retrievers under `ai.retriever` and query a store with the new `ai:store:retrieve` command.

1024.summary: `MessageBag` now implements `IteratorAggregate`, so you can loop over its messages with `foreach`.

1017.summary: Messages can now hold templates. Build a system or user message from `Template::string()` and pass the values in the `template_vars` option. The `TemplateRendererListener` renders the template before the request is sent.

1015.summary: New Decart platform bridge for generating images and videos. It supports text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video animation and image editing with the Lucy models.

1006.summary: `StoreInterface::query()` now returns an `iterable` instead of an array, and all stores yield their documents lazily.

1000.summary: New Cloudflare KV message store, which persists chat history in Workers KV. You configure it under `ai.message_store.cloudflare` with account ID, API key and namespace.

977.summary: The Clock, Scraper, SimilaritySearch, Wikipedia and YouTube tools move into separate packages, such as `symfony/ai-clock-tool`, under the `Symfony\AI\Agent\Bridge` namespace.

954.summary: The OpenMeteo and SerpApi tool packages are renamed to `symfony/ai-open-meteo-tool` and `symfony/ai-serp-api-tool`, to follow the package naming convention.

952.summary: The SerpApi tool moves into its own package with the namespace `Symfony\AI\Agent\Bridge\SerpApi`.

951.summary: The `$source` argument of `LoaderInterface::load()` is now optional, which helps loaders like `InMemoryLoader` that do not need a source.

948.summary: The OpenMeteo weather tool moves into its own package with the namespace `Symfony\AI\Agent\Bridge\OpenMeteo`. It provides the `weather_current` and `weather_forecast` tools.

947.summary: The Mapbox geocoding tool moves into its own package with the namespace `Symfony\AI\Agent\Bridge\Mapbox`.

946.summary: The Firecrawl tool moves into its own package with the namespace `Symfony\AI\Agent\Bridge\Firecrawl`.

944.summary: The Tavily search tool moves into its own package with the namespace `Symfony\AI\Agent\Bridge\Tavily`.

943.summary: Add speech to any agent with the new `SpeechAgent` decorator: it transcribes audio input, turns text replies into audio, or both. The bundle has a `speech` option for agents.

936.summary: The Anthropic bridge now supports structured output through the Claude structured outputs beta. You can pass `response_format` with a class or a JSON schema, as with other platforms.

932.summary: OpenRouter results now go through the OpenAI GPT result converter, which adds streaming support and better error messages.

920.summary: Each model under `ai.model` now has a `class` option, which defaults to `Symfony\AI\Platform\Model`. The bundle checks that the class exists and extends `Model`.

snippet.code:
ai:
    model:
        openai:
            my-custom-model:
                class: 'Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\OpenAi\Gpt'
                capabilities:
                    - !php/const 'Symfony\AI\Platform\Capability::INPUT_MESSAGES'
                    - !php/const 'Symfony\AI\Platform\Capability::OUTPUT_TEXT'

919.summary: The MCP Bundle now requires the first tagged release of the MCP PHP SDK, `mcp/sdk` ^0.1.

918.summary: MariaDB store queries accept a custom SQL `where` clause with bound `params`, combined with `maxScore`, to filter vector search results.

915.summary: The OpenRouter catalog is updated with current models. The new `ModelApiCatalog` loads models from the OpenRouter API, and both catalogs support `openrouter/auto` and `@preset/...` model names.

912.summary: You can now pass setup options such as `dimensions` to a MariaDB store via the bundle's `setup_options` key; they are used by the store setup command.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        mariadb:
            my_store:
                connection: 'default'
                table_name: 'embeddings'
                index_name: 'embedding_idx'
                vector_field_name: 'embedding'
                setup_options:
                    dimensions: 1536

910.summary: `OllamaApiCatalog` now fully implements `ModelCatalogInterface`. `getModels()` lists all models installed on the Ollama server, with their capabilities.

908.summary: The demo application gains a recipe generator that shows structured output in action, returning typed `Recipe` objects from the agent.

907.summary: New MongoDB message store, which persists chat history in a MongoDB collection. You configure it under `ai.message_store.mongodb` with client, database and collection.

904.summary: MariaDB vector stores can now be configured in the AI Bundle, using an existing Doctrine DBAL connection.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        mariadb:
            my_store:
                connection: 'default'
                table_name: 'embeddings'
                index_name: 'embedding_idx'
                vector_field_name: 'embedding'

896.summary: The Meilisearch message store now uses the Symfony Serializer with the `MessageNormalizer` to store and restore messages.

893.summary: Google's `gemini-3.0-pro-preview` model is now available in the Gemini and Vertex AI model catalogs, with support for images, audio, PDFs, streaming, structured output and tool calling.

892.summary: The ai.symfony.com homepage now features the smart cropping demo and a link to the #ai-initiative Slack channel.

891.summary: The code example on the ai.symfony.com homepage now animates through different model names.

889.summary: The Pogocache message store now uses the Symfony Serializer with the `MessageNormalizer` to store and restore messages.

887.summary: The ai.symfony.com website is now part of the monorepo.

884.summary: Chat history can now be persisted in any Doctrine DBAL database with the new `DoctrineDbalMessageStore`, also configurable in the AI Bundle under `message_store.doctrine.dbal`.

881.summary: You can now store chat messages in SurrealDB with the new SurrealDb `MessageStore`, available standalone or via the bundle's `message_store.surreal_db` configuration.

880.summary: You can now filter `InMemoryStore` and `CacheStore` query results by document metadata by passing a callable as the `filter` option to `query()`.

876.summary: Structured output now uses a single option: pass either a PHP class name or an array schema as `response_format`, instead of using `output_structure` for classes.

874.summary: Configured indexers and vectorizers are now registered as named autowiring aliases, so you can inject a specific `IndexerInterface` or `VectorizerInterface` by argument name.

872.summary: New LiteLLM platform bridge for chat completions through a LiteLLM proxy. You can use any model configured in LiteLLM.

871.summary: The OpenAI bridge now uses the Responses API instead of Chat Completions. Use `max_output_tokens` instead of `max_tokens`. Audio input is turned off for now because the Responses API does not support it yet.

866.summary: The MCP Bundle adds a Web Profiler panel. It lists the registered MCP tools, prompts, resources and resource templates, with their descriptions and schemas.

864.summary: MonologBundle is now optional for the MCP Bundle. Without it, the container still compiles; before, it failed because `monolog.logger_prototype` was missing.

861.summary: The demo's audio bot now runs speech-to-text-to-speech, answering out loud and delegating Symfony questions to a RAG subagent.

858.summary: You can now generate speech from text with OpenAI's `tts-1`, `tts-1-hd` and `gpt-4o-mini-tts` models; pick a voice from the `Voice` constants and get binary audio back.

851.summary: The demo application gains a smart image cropping example built on Hugging Face object detection.

850.summary: Hugging Face can now be configured as a platform in the AI Bundle, including the inference `provider` to route requests through.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        huggingface:
            api_key: '%env(HUGGINGFACE_KEY)%'
            provider: 'hf-inference'

848.summary: The Hugging Face bridge adds an `ApiClient` plus `ModelListCommand` and `ModelInfoCommand` console commands to discover available models by task or provider.

844.summary: The OpenRouter bridge now supports embedding models and ships a filled model catalog; authentication, bad-request and rate-limit errors are mapped to dedicated exceptions.

843.summary: The bundle now supports in-memory message stores, configurable cache keys and TTLs for cache-based message stores, and a `cache_key` option for cache vector stores; message stores are lazy and autowirable by name.

snippet.code:
ai:
    message_store:
        memory:
            session:
                identifier: 'session'
        cache:
            youtube:
                service: 'cache.app'
                key: 'youtube'
                ttl: 3600

839.summary: The Albert model catalog now lists the current API models `albert-small`, `albert-large` and `embeddings-small`.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('albert-large', $messages);
echo $result->asText();

837.summary: The Albert platform can now be configured in the AI Bundle under `ai.platform.albert`.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        albert:
            api_key: '%env(ALBERT_API_KEY)%'
            base_url: '%env(ALBERT_API_URL)%'

835.summary: Manticore Search is now supported as a vector store, standalone or via the bundle's `store.manticore` configuration with options for field, similarity, dimensions and quantization.

834.summary: Qdrant writes now wait for the operation to finish by default, so errors surface immediately; set `async` to `true` to keep fire-and-forget behaviour.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        qdrant:
            my_store:
                endpoint: '%env(QDRANT_HOST)%'
                api_key: '%env(QDRANT_API_KEY)%'
                collection_name: 'documents'
                async: false

827.summary: Streamed Ollama chunks now expose the model's reasoning via `getThinking()`, the raw payload (including final stats and token usage) via `$raw`, and `isDone()`.

826.summary: The `gpt-oss` model is now part of the Ollama model catalog, with structured output and tool calling.

824.summary: Cartesia is now supported as a voice platform: generate speech with `sonic-3` and transcribe audio with `ink-whisper`, standalone or via the bundle's `cartesia` platform config.

818.summary: The `Brave`, `SerpApi`, `Tavily` and `Clock` tools now report sources, and the new `Scraper` tool loads the title and visible text of a web page by URL.

815.summary: The examples runner now runs examples in parallel chunks with a live status table, configurable via `--chunk`.

811.summary: Voyage AI's `voyage-multimodal-3` model now lets you embed text, images and image URLs, and combine several of them into one vector with a `Collection`.

809.summary: Tool calls now work with streamed Ollama responses, so agents can call tools while streaming.

808.summary: You can now control which directories the MCP Bundle scans for tools with `discovery.scan_dirs` and `discovery.exclude_dirs`.

snippet.code:
mcp:
    discovery:
        scan_dirs: ['src', 'lib']
        exclude_dirs: ['src/DataFixtures']

802.summary: Structured output moved from the Agent to the Platform: register the `PlatformSubscriber` on the platform's event dispatcher and use it with or without an agent. Models without structured output support are now rejected.

797.summary: Chat history can now be stored in Redis with the new Redis `MessageStore`, which serializes messages through the Serializer and a new `MessageNormalizer`; the bundle accepts either `connection_parameters` or a `client` service.

788.summary: Pogocache can now be used as a message store for chat history through its HTTP API, standalone or via the bundle's `message_store.pogocache` config.

787.summary: Mistral models now accept `ImageUrl` content, so you can pass remote images by URL; the Mistral platform also uses its own contract by default.

782.summary: The Meilisearch store now supports hybrid search: set `semanticRatio` (0.0 full-text to 1.0 semantic) on the store or per query to balance keyword and vector matching. The bundle exposes it as `semantic_ratio`.

777.summary: `DynamicModelCatalog` is renamed to `FallbackModelCatalog`, which better describes a catalog that accepts any model name with all capabilities.

771.summary: Agents in the bundle gain `keep_tool_messages`, `include_sources` and `fault_tolerant_toolbox` options, and the profiler now shows result metadata such as tool sources.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        wikipedia:
            platform: 'ai.platform.openai'
            model: 'gpt-5-mini'
            keep_tool_messages: true
            include_sources: true
            fault_tolerant_toolbox: true

766.summary: The new `OllamaApiCatalog` reads model capabilities from your Ollama server's API, so you can use custom models built from a `Modelfile` that the static catalog does not list. In the bundle, enable it with `api_catalog: true`.

765.summary: You can now configure chats and message stores in the AI Bundle; in debug mode they are traced and shown in the Symfony profiler.

snippet.code:
ai:
    message_store:
        cache:
            youtube:
                service: 'cache.app'
                key: 'youtube'
    chat:
        youtube:
            agent: 'ai.agent.youtube'
            message_store: 'ai.message_store.cache.youtube'

764.summary: Tools can now expose the sources behind their results by implementing `HasSourcesInterface` with `HasSourcesTrait`; the agent collects them in the result metadata under `sources`.

758.summary: Message and content classes now use private properties with getters, and every message carries a `Metadata` object you can read and write.

754.summary: Streamed agent responses now carry `token_usage` metadata, starting with OpenAI, so you can track costs for streaming calls too.

746.summary: A Postgres vector store in the bundle can now reuse an existing Doctrine DBAL connection via `dbal_connection` instead of a `dsn`.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        postgres:
            my_store:
                dbal_connection: 'doctrine.dbal.default_connection'
                table_name: 'vectors'

745.summary: `ResultPromise` is renamed to `DeferredResult`, which `PlatformInterface::invoke()` now returns; it is built with an explicit `ResultConverterInterface` instead of a closure.

740.summary: The demo gains an `app:blog:stream` console command that shows streamed agent output in the terminal.

739.summary: `ExecutionReference` properties are now private and exposed through `getClass()` and `getMethod()`.

738.summary: `Tool` metadata properties are now private and accessed through getters such as `getName()`, `getDescription()`, `getParameters()` and `getReference()`.

737.summary: `ToolCall` properties are now private; read them with `getId()`, `getName()` and `getArguments()`.

736.summary: `BinaryResult` properties are now private, with a new `getMimeType()` getter alongside the existing accessors.

snippet.code:
$result = $platform->invoke('gpt-4o-mini-tts', 'Hello!', ['voice' => 'coral'])->getResult();

$mimeType = $result->getMimeType();

734.summary: Message stores can now be configured in the AI Bundle (`memory`, `cache`, `session`) and set up or dropped with the new `ai:message-store:setup` and `ai:message-store:drop` commands.

snippet.code:
php bin/console ai:message-store:setup symfonycon
php bin/console ai:message-store:drop symfonycon --force

733.summary: Postgres (pgvector) stores can now be configured in the AI Bundle with a DSN, optional credentials, table name, vector field and distance function.

snippet.code:
ai:
    store:
        postgres:
            my_store:
                dsn: 'pgsql:host=localhost;port=5432;dbname=app'
                username: 'app'
                password: '%env(DATABASE_PASSWORD)%'
                table_name: 'vectors'
                distance: 'cosine'

732.summary: `Vectorizer::vectorize()` now handles strings, `Stringable` objects, embeddable documents and arrays of either, replacing the separate document method; PHPStan infers the matching return type.

725.summary: Message stores can now implement `ManagedStoreInterface` with `setup()` and `drop()`; the in-memory, cache and session stores support it, and `Chat` uses it to reset conversations.

723.summary: `RateLimitExceededException::getRetryAfter()` now returns an integer number of seconds, and the OpenAI bridge parses its rate-limit reset headers into it.

720.summary: Result accessors, `ResultConverterInterface::convert()` and `Agent::call()` now document the platform `ExceptionInterface` they can throw.

715.summary: System prompts can now be loaded from a file (JSON, TXT or Markdown): pass a `File` to `SystemPromptInputProcessor` or use `prompt.file` in the bundle.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        reviewer:
            model: 'gpt-5-mini'
            prompt:
                file: '%kernel.project_dir%/prompts/code-reviewer.json'

714.summary: Model names with colon notation such as `qwen3:0.6b` are now kept intact when you configure them in the AI Bundle.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        local:
            platform: 'ai.platform.ollama'
            model: 'qwen3:0.6b'

712.summary: Model catalogs now resolve size variants like `qwen3:32b` to their base model's capabilities while sending the full name to the provider; query options still work.

711.summary: `UserMessage::asText()` returns the joined text parts of a user message, or `null` if it has none.

snippet.code:
$userMessage = $messages->getUserMessage();

$text = $userMessage?->asText();

709.summary: The toolbox now dispatches `ToolCallSucceeded` and `ToolCallFailed` events, so you can react to the result or failure of each tool call.

707.summary: The new `EmbeddableDocumentInterface` lets you index your own document classes instead of only `TextDocument`; loaders, transformers and the vectorizer now work with the interface.

694.summary: The Bedrock bridge uses the Anthropic `Claude` model class again, as the Anthropic contract normalizers only support that class.

688.summary: ElevenLabs models now declare `Capability::TEXT_TO_SPEECH` or `Capability::SPEECH_TO_TEXT`, and the client picks the endpoint based on the model's capabilities instead of hardcoded model names.

687.summary: The Bedrock bridge ships its own `Bedrock\Anthropic\Claude` model class instead of depending on the Anthropic bridge's class.

683.summary: The `ai:chat` command is renamed to `ai:agent:call`; `ai:chat` stays available as an alias.

snippet.code: bin/console ai:agent:call my_agent

682.summary: `Toolbox\AgentProcessor` no longer throws when a model does not declare the tool calling capability, so you can use tools with any model.

675.summary: Chats and message stores now live in the new `symfony/ai-chat` component, which keeps conversation storage separate from the Agent component.

669.summary: Ollama Qwen models with a size suffix like `qwen3:32b` or `qwen2.5-coder:32b` are now recognized and get their capabilities, such as tool calling.

snippet.code:
use Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\Ollama\Ollama;

$model = new Ollama(Ollama::QWEN_3_32B);

654.summary: The Anthropic `Claude` and Bedrock `Nova` model classes no longer set a default `max_tokens`; pass it explicitly in the model options if you need it.

snippet.code: $model = new Claude(Claude::SONNET_37, ['max_tokens' => 1000]);

653.summary: Model classes like `Claude`, `Gpt`, `Mistral`, `Nova`, `ElevenLabs` and `Perplexity` no longer have a default model name, so you always pass the model name explicitly.

642.summary: Append model options as query parameters to the model name in the bundle configuration, for agents as well as vectorizers.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            model:
                class: 'Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\OpenAi\Gpt'
                name: 'gpt-4o-mini?temperature=0.7&max_tokens=2000'

641.summary: Stores configured in the AI Bundle are also autowirable by `<type>_<name>`, so you can reuse the same store name across store types without injection conflicts.

640.summary: Models are now resolved from a per-bridge `ModelCatalog`, so you pass plain model names as strings to `invoke()`, `Agent` and `Vectorizer` instead of instantiating model classes. Model constants are removed.

638.summary: Give the `Clock` tool a timezone so the agent gets the current date and time in that zone instead of the server default.

637.summary: The MCP Bundle now builds on the official `mcp/sdk` package. Expose tools, prompts, resources and resource templates with `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpPrompt]`, `#[McpResource]` and `#[McpResourceTemplate]`; they are discovered automatically.

635.summary: Pass a `TranslatableMessage` (or any `TranslatableInterface`) as the system prompt of `SystemPromptInputProcessor` to translate it, including translation parameters.

634.summary: The Brave Search tool moves into its own package with the namespace `Symfony\AI\Agent\Bridge\Brave`. It is the first tool split into a dedicated bridge package.

628.summary: Add `ModelNotFoundException`, thrown by the Docker Model Runner bridge when the requested model is not available locally, so you can catch typos or missing downloads.

621.summary: Add `FilterInterface` and `TextContainsFilter` to drop unwanted documents in the `Indexer` after loading and before transforming; filters are also configurable per indexer in the AI Bundle.

620.summary: The demo's blog query command uses the configured `VectorizerInterface` service instead of calling the platform directly.

609.summary: The AI/ML API bridge now provides constants for its available completion and embedding models, plus examples for tool calling and vectorizing.

608.summary: Gemini and OpenAI errors now surface the original API error code, status and message instead of a generic "Response does not contain any content" exception.

604.summary: Set a custom HTTP client service per platform in the AI Bundle to control timeouts, proxies or SSL settings.

snippet.code:
ai:
    platform:
        openai:
            api_key: '%env(OPENAI_API_KEY)%'
            http_client: 'app.custom_http_client'

601.summary: Add model constants for Gemini 2.5 Flash, Pro and Flash Lite, and for Mistral Medium, Ministral 3B and 8B, with Mistral Medium getting its image input capability.

snippet.code:
$gemini = new Gemini(Gemini::GEMINI_25_FLASH);
$mistral = new Mistral(Mistral::MISTRAL_MEDIUM);

598.summary: Add an AI/ML API platform bridge for chat completions and embeddings through its OpenAI-compatible API.

595.summary: Agent `memory` configuration is now explicit: a string always creates static memory, and an array with a `service` key references a memory provider service.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            memory:
                service: 'my_memory_service'

594.summary: The AI Bundle validates during configuration processing that a configured model `class` extends `Symfony\AI\Platform\Model`, giving earlier and clearer errors.

590.summary: The platform now requires `codewithkyrian/transformers` ^0.6.2 for the TransformersPHP bridge.

589.summary: The AI Bundle configuration uses `stringNode()` and `integerNode()` for typed values like API keys, URLs and dimensions, so invalid types are rejected early.

585.summary: Structured output now supports native union types and lists of polymorphic objects, using Symfony Serializer's `#[DiscriminatorMap]` to deserialize the right class.

584.summary: `MemoryProviderInterface::loadMemory()` is renamed to `load()`; update your custom memory providers accordingly.

583.summary: Configure agent memory in the AI Bundle with a `memory` key: static text or a memory provider service, prepended to the system prompt or used as one.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            model:
                class: 'Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\OpenAi\Gpt'
                name: 'gpt-4o-mini'
            memory: 'You have access to user preferences and conversation history'
            prompt:
                text: 'You are a helpful assistant.'

581.summary: Memory content is now placed before the system prompt, separated by a `# System Prompt` headline.

580.summary: `SystemPromptInputProcessor` now introduces the appended tool definitions under a `# Tools` headline with clearer instructions.

579.summary: The agent `system_prompt` option is renamed to `prompt`, and its nested `prompt` key to `text`.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            prompt:
                text: 'You are a helpful assistant that can answer questions.'
                include_tools: true

577.summary: Model classes no longer default to a model name and reject empty names, so you always pass the model name explicitly, e.g. `new Embeddings(Embeddings::TEXT_3_SMALL)`.

576.summary: Configure `system_prompt` as a plain string or as an array that nests `include_tools`, instead of a separate agent-level `include_tools` option.

snippet.code:
ai:
    agent:
        my_agent:
            system_prompt:
                prompt: 'You are a helpful assistant that can answer questions.'
                include_tools: true

575.summary: The platform now dispatches an `InvocationEvent` before each call, so listeners can change model, input or options. The `StringToMessageBagListener` lets you pass a plain string to chat models.

571.summary: Add `RssFeedLoader` to load RSS feed items as text documents into the indexing pipeline, with stable UUIDv5 identifiers.

564.summary: The AI Bundle registers the Perplexity contract, token usage processor and search result processor as services.

554.summary: Add an Anthropic `TokenOutputProcessor` that adds prompt, completion, cached and tool token usage to the result metadata.

553.summary: DeepSeek is now available as a platform, with `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner`, streaming, tool calling, structured output and token usage tracking.

551.summary: Supabase is now supported as a vector store through its REST API and pgvector, standalone or via the bundle's `store.supabase` configuration. The database schema has to be set up manually.

548.summary: Pass platform options to `Vectorizer::vectorize()` and `vectorizeTextDocuments()`, for example to set embedding dimensions per call.

snippet.code:
$vector = $vectorizer->vectorize('Hello World', ['dimensions' => 512]);

$vectorDocuments = $vectorizer->vectorizeTextDocuments($documents, ['dimensions' => 512]);

547.summary: `VectorizerInterface::vectorize()` now accepts `\Stringable` objects as well as strings.

snippet.code: $vector = $vectorizer->vectorize($stringableObject);

544.summary: The new `ai:platform:invoke` command sends a message to any configured platform and model, which is handy for checking platform configuration.

snippet.code: php bin/console ai:platform:invoke openai gpt-5-mini "Hello, world!"

543.summary: The OpenAI bridge throws an `AuthenticationException` with the API's error message on HTTP 401, instead of a confusing "Response does not contain choices" error.

537.summary: Configure Perplexity as a platform in the AI Bundle and use it for agents.

snippet.code:

    platform:
        perplexity:
            api_key: '%env(PERPLEXITY_API_KEY)%'

                class: 'Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\Perplexity\Perplexity'
                name: !php/const Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\Perplexity\Perplexity::SONAR

517.summary: Use `MultiAgent` to let an orchestrator agent route each request to specialized agents via `Handoff` rules, with a fallback agent for everything else.

515.summary: Add a Docker Model Runner bridge to run local models for chat, tool calling and embeddings, also configurable as `dockermodelrunner` platform in the AI Bundle.

514.summary: Translate agent system prompts with the Symfony translator, so you can write prompts per locale; enable it per agent with `enable_translation` and an optional `translation_domain`.

snippet.code:

    agent:
        my_agent:
            prompt:
                text: 'agent.system_prompt'
                enable_translation: true
                translation_domain: 'prompts'

512.summary: Agents configured in the AI Bundle get their configuration key as name.

509.summary: Add `getName()` to `AgentInterface` so you can identify agents, for example for debugging or multi-agent setups.

snippet.code:
$agent = new Agent($platform, $model, name: 'support');

echo $agent->getName(); // "support"

508.summary: Use Mistral's Voxtral models with audio input, for example to transcribe audio files.

502.summary: Use `MockAgent` in tests to get predictable responses without API calls, and assert on how your code called the agent, similar to `MockHttpClient`.

500.summary: Add a `Mapbox` tool so agents can geocode addresses to coordinates and reverse geocode coordinates to addresses.

497.summary: Add `AGENTS.md` files with guidance for AI coding agents working on the Symfony AI repository.

494.summary: Backed enums used as tool parameters now produce a JSON schema `enum` with their values automatically, without a `#[With]` attribute.

493.summary: The OpenAI contract's `FileNormalizer` is renamed to `DocumentNormalizer`.

491.summary: The demo's blog commands now use Symfony 7.3 invokable commands.

484.summary: Add `InMemoryLoader` to feed a fixed list of `TextDocument` objects into an indexer, which is handy for tests.

482.summary: Configure chunk size and overlap of `TextSplitTransformer` in its constructor.

snippet.code:
use Symfony\AI\Store\Document\Transformer\TextSplitTransformer;

$transformer = new TextSplitTransformer(chunkSize: 500, overlap: 100);

481.summary: `VectorizerInterface` now separates `vectorize()` for a single string from `vectorizeTextDocuments()` for document batches.

479.summary: Add `TextDocument::withContent()` to create a copy of a document with new content but the same id and metadata.

snippet.code: $cleaned = $document->withContent(trim($document->content));

417.summary: Use Cloudflare Vectorize as a vector store via the new `Cloudflare\Store`, with index setup, upserts and similarity queries. It is also configurable as a `cloudflare` store in the AI Bundle.

398.summary: Use Weaviate as a vector store via the new `Weaviate\Store`, which creates the collection, batch-inserts documents and queries with `nearVector`. It is also available as a `weaviate` store in the AI Bundle.

395.summary: Chat with any configured agent from the terminal using the new `ai:chat` console command. It keeps the conversation history and prompts you to pick an agent if you don't pass one.

394.summary: Add a Scaleway platform bridge with chat, streaming, tool calling, structured output, vision and embeddings via its OpenAI-compatible API.

php rag/clickhouse.php

        voyage:
            api_key: '%env(VOYAGE_API_KEY)%'

359.summary: Voyage embeddings now accept `input_type`, `dimensions` and `truncation` options, and the new `voyage-3.5`, `voyage-3.5-lite`, `voyage-3-large` and `voyage-code-3` models. `voyage-3.5` is now the default.

357.summary: Attach files such as PDFs to OpenAI GPT messages with `File::fromFile()`. The new `OpenAiContract` sends them base64-encoded with their file name to the Chat Completions API.

352.summary: Register input and output processors with `#[AsInputProcessor]` and `#[AsOutputProcessor]`, scoped to one agent or to all agents, and control their order with a `priority`.

351.summary: Configure Cerebras as a platform in the AI Bundle with the new `cerebras` config node.

    platform:
        cerebras:
            api_key: '%env(CEREBRAS_API_KEY)%'

349.summary: Every agent configured in the AI Bundle is now tagged `ai.agent`, so you can inject all of them at once or collect them in a compiler pass.

348.summary: Get the model an agent uses with `Agent::getModel()`, for example to log the model name without reflection.

snippet.code:

340.summary: Filter ChromaDB similarity queries by metadata and document content with the `where` and `whereDocument` query options.

bin/console ai:store:drop my_store --force

334.summary: The Platform component now also accepts `codewithkyrian/transformers` ^0.6.1, next to ^0.5.3.

329.summary: The AI Bundle now registers token usage output processors for OpenAI, Mistral and Vertex AI agents automatically. Usage ends up in the result metadata; turn it off per agent with `track_token_usage`.

            model:
                class: 'Symfony\AI\Platform\Bridge\OpenAi\Gpt'

324.summary: Stream ElevenLabs text-to-speech audio chunk by chunk: set the `stream` option on the model and read the result with `asStream()`.

314.summary: Use Milvus as a vector store via the new `Milvus\Store`, also configurable as a `milvus` store in the AI Bundle. The PR also adds `DroppableStoreInterface` for removing a store's database.

        milvus:

297.summary: Use Google Vertex AI as a platform for Gemini chat, embeddings, multimodal input, tool calling, structured output and server-side tools. It authenticates with Application Default Credentials through your HTTP client.

292.summary: Use ElevenLabs as a platform for text-to-speech and speech-to-text (Scribe) models, either directly or through the `eleven_labs` platform config in the AI Bundle.

288.summary: Keep the original chunk text, source and parent ID on store documents with new `Metadata` helpers. `TextSplitTransformer` and `TextFileLoader` set them for you, and ChromaDB stores the text as the record's document.

284.summary: Use Cerebras as a platform for fast inference with models such as Llama 4, Qwen 3 and gpt-oss, with streaming support.

281.summary: Autowire a specific agent by naming the argument after it with an `Agent` suffix, e.g. `$researchAgent` for the `research` agent.

277.summary: Symfony AI now requires Symfony 7.3 or higher and supports Symfony 8.0; Symfony 6.4 is no longer supported.

274.summary: Turn on Anthropic beta features by passing a `beta_features` option. The flags are sent as the `anthropic-beta` header.

270.summary: Let agents scrape, crawl and map websites with the new `Firecrawl` tool, which exposes `firecrawl_scrape`, `firecrawl_crawl` and `firecrawl_map`.

269.summary: Redis is now supported as a vector store using RediSearch, with a configurable key prefix and `Distance` metric; configure it in the bundle with `connection_parameters` or a `client` service.

    platform:
        ollama:
            host_url: '%env(OLLAMA_HOST_URL)%'

244.summary: Use ClickHouse as a vector store with cosine-distance queries and custom `where` filters with bound parameters. It is also configurable as a `clickhouse` store in the AI Bundle.

211.summary: Run toolbox agents on Ollama: tool calls and tool results now work with tool-capable models such as Llama 3.x, Qwen, Mistral and DeepSeek.

111.summary: Use Qdrant as a vector store via the new `Qdrant\Store`, which uses the HTTP query API and supports `limit` and `offset` query options.
